cards.name: The Pit of Despair
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-2 instead if your location is partially flooded; -3 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail and your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and you control a key, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail and The Amalgam is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你所在地點部分淹沒，改為-2；如果你所在地點完全淹沒，改為-3)。
[cultist]：-2。如果你檢定失敗且你所在地點已淹沒，受到1點傷害。
[tablet]：-2。如果你檢定失敗且你控制鑰匙，受到1點恐懼。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你檢定失敗且混生畸物在深淵中，將其放置入場，與你交戰。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-3 instead if your location is partially flooded; -4 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[cultist]: -2. If your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you control a key, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -3. If The Amalgam is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2(如果你所在地點部分淹沒，改為-3；如果你所在地點完全淹沒，改為-4)。
[cultist]：-2。如果你所在地點已淹沒，受到1點傷害。
[tablet]：-2。如果你控制鑰匙，受到1點恐懼。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果混生畸物在深淵中，將其放置入場，與你交戰。

cards.name: Awakening
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text:
Increase the flood level of each revealed location.
Until the end of the game, each time a location is revealed, increase its flood level.
Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to agenda 2a.
cards.back_text_cn:
提升每個已揭示地點的淹沒等級。
直到遊戲結束，每當揭示地點時，提升其淹沒等級。
將本卡牌放到場景牌堆旁以作提醒，推進到密謀2a。

cards.name: The Water Rises
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text:
Each revealed location becomes fully flooded.
Until the end of the game, each time a location is revealed, it becomes fully flooded.
Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder (replacing agenda 1b), and advance to agenda 3a.
cards.back_text_cn:
每個已揭示的地點變為完全淹沒。
直到遊戲結束，每當揭示地點時，其完全淹沒。
將本卡牌放到場景牌堆旁以作提醒(取代密謀1b)，推進到密謀3a。

cards.name: Sacrifice for the Deep
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and takes 1 physical trauma.
cards.back_text_cn: 每位倖存的調查員被擊敗並受到1點肉體創傷。

cards.name: The Pit
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Amalgam enemy engaged with the lead investigator. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Blindsense and From the Depths into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Shuffle each of the set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations together to form the Tidal Tunnel deck (including the set-aside Altar to Dagon, Idol Chamber, and Sealed Exit locations). Put locations from the top of the Tidal Tunnel deck into play below, to the left, and to the right of each revealed location. Read Flashback I in the Campaign Guide.
cards.back_text_cn: 生成放在一邊的混生畸物敵人，與調查員隊長交戰。 將放在一邊的每張有眼無珠和來自深淵，以及遭遇棄牌堆一起，混洗入遭遇牌堆。 混洗所有放在一邊的潮水通道地點，組成潮水通道牌堆(包括放在一邊的達貢祭壇、偶像洞室、封印出口地點)。從潮水通道牌堆頂將地點放置入場，放在每個已揭示地點的下方、左方和右方。 閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回I。

cards.name: The Escape
cards.text: Forced - After a location is revealed: Put locations from the top of the Tidal Tunnel deck into play below, to the left, and to the right of that location. Objective - There must be a way out of here somewhere. If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在一個地點揭示後：從潮水通道牌堆頂將地點放置入場，放在該地點的下方、左方和右方。 目標 - 這兒一定有路能出去。如果所有倖存的調查員都已撤退，推進場景。

cards.name: Unfamiliar Chamber
cards.text: Forced - After Unfamiliar Chamber is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Unfamiliar Chamber without looking at it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在陌生洞室揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到陌生洞室上，不要查看。

cards.name: Bone-Ridden Pit
cards.text: For each key controlled by an investigator at Bone-Ridden Pit, it gets -1 shroud. [fast] If there are no clues on Bone-Ridden Pit and you control the yellow key: You notice an odd joint socket near the skeleton's midsection that matches the shape of the yellow key. Read Flashback II in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: 廢棄骨坑的調查員每控制一個鑰匙，其隱藏值-1。 [free]如果廢棄骨坑沒有線索，且你控制了黃色鑰匙：你注意到這具遺骨的中間部分缺了一塊，正好和黃色鑰匙的形狀一致。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回II。

cards.name: Fish Graveyard
cards.text: Forced - After you end your turn at Fish Graveyard, if you do not control a key: Take 1 horror. [fast] If there are no clues on Fish Graveyard and you control the red key: Inside a pile of half-rotten fish guts, you find a strange figurine the red key fits into perfectly. Read Flashback III in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你在群魚墳場結束自己的回合後，如果你沒有控制鑰匙：受到1點恐懼。 [free]如果群魚墳場沒有線索，且你控制了紅色鑰匙：你在一堆半腐的魚內臟中間找到了一個奇怪的雕像，和紅色鑰匙嚴絲合縫。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回III。

cards.name: Altar to Dagon
cards.text: [action] If investigators at Altar to Dagon control the blue key or three or more other keys, they may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Take control of the set-aside green key.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果在達貢祭壇的調查員控制了藍色鑰匙，或至少3個其它鑰匙，則可以以團隊為單位，花費2[per_investigator]一個線索：控制放在一邊的綠色鑰匙。

cards.name: Idol Chamber
cards.text: Forced - After Idol Chamber is revealed: Place the set-aside blue key on it. [fast] If there are no clues on Idol Chamber and you control the purple key: The purple key opens the stone door at the far end of the chamber, revealing a shrine with two familiar statues, one of white marble, the other of onyx. Read Flashback IV in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在偶像洞室揭示後：將放在一邊的藍色鑰匙放在其上面。 [free]如果偶像洞室沒有線索，且你控制了紫色鑰匙：紫色鑰匙打開了洞室遠端的石門，裡面的神龕裡有兩尊相仿的雕像，一尊是白色大理石，另一尊是縞瑪瑙。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回IV。

cards.name: Sealed Exit
cards.text: [action] If an investigator at Sealed Exit controls the green key: Resign. You unlock the grate and swim through the tunnel to freedom. Return all of your clues to the token pool and place all of your keys on this location when you resign. Forced - After Sealed Exit is revealed: It becomes fully flooded.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果封印出口的調查員控制了綠色鑰匙：撤退。你打開頂蓋，游出隧道，重獲自由。在你撤退時，將你的所有線索返回供應堆，並將你的所有鑰匙放在本地點。 強制 - 在封印出口揭示後：其完全淹沒。

cards.name: The Amalgam
cards.text: Hunter. [reaction] After you successfully evade The Amalgam by 2 or more: Take control of 1 key on it. Forced - After The Amalgam engages you, if you control a key: Either place 1 of your keys on it, or it attacks you. Forced - When The Amalgam is defeated: Place it in the depths.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 [reaction]在你躲避混生畸物成功且高於難度2點或更多後：控制它的1個鑰匙。 強制 - 在混生畸物與你交戰後，如果你控制了鑰匙：將你的1個鑰匙放在它上面，或它攻擊你。 強制 - 在混生畸物被擊敗時：將其放入深淵。

cards.name: Blindsense
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail and The Amalgam... - ...is in play, it readies, moves directly to your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack. - ...is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you. It makes an immediate attack.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定失敗且混生畸物…… - ……在場上，它準備，直接移動到你所在地點，與你交戰並立即進行一次攻擊。 - ……在深淵中，將其放置入場，與你交戰。它立即進行一次攻擊。

cards.name: From the Depths
cards.text: Revelation - If The Amalgam is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you. Otherwise, place The Amalgam in the depths and From the Depths gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果混生畸物在深淵中, 將其放置入場，與你交戰。 否則，將混生畸物放入深淵，來自深淵獲得湧動。

cards.name: The Vanishing of Elina Harper
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest enemy.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。X為當前密謀編號。
[cultist]：-2。如果你檢定失敗，在最近的敵人身上放置1個毀滅標記。
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點恐懼。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你檢定失敗，在你所在地點放置你的1個線索。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy (2 doom instead if you failed).
[tablet]: -3. Take 1 horror (1 horror and 1 damage instead if you failed).
[elder_thing]: -4. Place 1 of your clues on your location (2 clues instead if you failed).
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。X為當前密謀編號+1。
[cultist]：-2。在最近的敵人身上放置1個毀滅標記(如果你檢定失敗，改為放置2個)。
[tablet]：-3。受到1點恐懼(如果你檢定失敗，改為受到1點恐懼和1點傷害)。
[elder_thing]：-4。在你所在地點放置你的1個線索(如果你檢定失敗。改為放置2個)。

cards.name: Decrepit Decay
cards.text: Forced - If you defeat a [[Suspect]] enemy other than the kidnapper: Take control of each clue on that enemy. Record in your Campaign Log (name of enemy) is out for blood.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果你擊敗了非綁架犯的[[嫌犯]]敵人：控制該敵人的所有線索。在冒險日誌中，記錄(該敵人名字)要你血債血償。
cards.back_text:
The town of Innsmouth grows more and more hostile with each day that passes. The townsfolk have caught on to your presence, and perhaps even the reason for your visit.
Shuffle the set-aside Winged One and both Hunting Nightgaunts into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
If a decision to stick together is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log:
After several days of investigation, you meet up with Agent Dawson to check in with him. He shows you a figurine of emerald stone depicting some sort of aquatic monstrosity, a piece of heart-shaped amber embedded in its center. After the days you have spent investigating and researching this foul place, the creature is oddly familiar to you. "I'm glad I roped you in on this case," Dawson says. "It's looking less and less like mob work with each passing hour. Let's stick together from here on out."
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Thomas Dawson story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的長翼者敵人，兩張狩獵中的夜魘和遭遇棄牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果在冒險日誌中的"恢復記憶"下方列出了一起行動的決定：
調查數日之後，你和道森特工碰頭，核對情況。他掏出一件綠寶石雕像，看著是某種水生怪物，中央嵌著一塊心型的琥珀。你調查研究這腐爛之地已有數日，看到這東西竟覺得莫名得熟悉。"我很慶幸把你捲進來了。"道森說道，"這事情越看越不像是黑幫幹的。我們接下來還是一起行動吧。"
選擇一位調查員控制放在一邊的托馬斯·道森劇情支援。他不佔用盟友槽，直到本場冒險結束。

cards.name: Growing Suspicion
cards.text: Forced - If you defeat a [[Suspect]] enemy other than the kidnapper: Take control of each clue on that enemy. Record in your Campaign Log (name of enemy) is out for blood. (Hint: If you do not make an accusation by the time this agenda advances, you will run out of time!)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果你擊敗了非綁架犯的[[嫌犯]]敵人：控制該敵人的所有線索。在冒險日誌中，記錄(該敵人名字)要你血債血償。 (提示：如果等到本密謀推進你還沒有發起指控，那就沒時間了！)

cards.name: Frantic Pursuit
cards.text: Forced - If you defeat a [[Suspect]] enemy other than the kidnapper: Take control of each clue on that enemy. Record in your Campaign Log (name of enemy) is out for blood.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果你擊敗了非綁架犯的[[嫌犯]]敵人：控制該敵人的所有線索。在冒險日誌中，記錄(該敵人名字)要你血債血償。

cards.name: The Search for Agent Harper
cards.text: [fast] The investigators spend X [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Reveal the top X cards of the Leads deck (to a maximum of 3) and draw 1 of them. Shuffle the rest back into the Leads deck, along with the top card of the encounter deck. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - You may advance at the end of any round. (Hint: You will have to make an accusation when you advance. Advance when you believe you have narrowed down Agent Harper's kidnapper and whereabouts.)
cards.text_cn: [free]調查員以團隊為單位，花費X[per_investigator]個線索：談判。翻開跡象牌堆頂的X張卡牌(最多3張)並抽取其中1張。將其餘卡牌和遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌一起混洗入跡象牌堆。(團隊每輪限制一次。) 目標 - 當任意一輪結束時，你都可以推進場景。(提示：你將在推進時發起指控。在你確信自己已經縮小了範圍，足夠找到哈珀特工的綁架者和藏身處時推進。)
cards.back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Accusation in the Campaign Guide.
cards.back_text_cn: 閱讀劇本手冊中的冒險幕間故事：指控。

cards.name: The Rescue
cards.text: The kidnapper loses aloof, gets +1 [per_investigator] health, and cannot be parleyed with. Objective - If either the kidnapper is in the victory display, or there are no clues on Elina Harper's location, advance (if there are 2 or more investigators in the game, both conditions must be fulfilled, instead).
cards.text_cn: 綁架犯失去冷漠，得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，且不能與之談判。 目標 - 如果綁架犯在勝利牌區，或艾蓮娜·哈珀的地點沒有線索，推進場景(如果遊戲中有至少2位調查員，則改為兩項條件都必須滿足)。
cards.back_text: - If Brian Burnham was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R2). - If Othera Gilman was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R3). - If Joyce Little was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R4). - If Barnabas Marsh was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R5). - If Zadok Allen was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R6). - If Robert Friendly was the kidnapper, proceed to (→R7).
cards.back_text_cn: - 如果布里安·伯納姆是綁架犯，進入(→結局2)。 - 如果歐斯拉·吉爾曼是綁架犯，進入(→結局3)。 - 如果喬伊斯·小利透是綁架犯，進入(→結局4)。 - 如果巴納巴斯·馬什是綁架犯，進入(→結局5)。 - 如果扎多克·艾倫是綁架犯，進入(→結局6)。 - 如果羅伯特·弗蘭得禮是綁架犯，進入(→結局7)。

cards.name: Finding Agent Harper
cards.text: Possible Suspects Brian Burnham Othera Gilman Joyce Little Barnabas Marsh Zadok Allen Robert Friendly Possible Hideouts Innsmouth Jail Shoreward Slums Sawbone Alley The House on Water Street Esoteric Order of Dagon New Church Green
cards.text_cn: 可能嫌犯 布里安·伯納姆 歐斯拉·吉爾曼 喬伊斯·小利透 巴納巴斯·馬什 扎多克·艾倫 羅伯特·弗蘭得禮 可能窩點 印斯茅斯監獄 朝岸貧民窟 鋸骨巷 水街老屋 達貢密教 新格林教堂

cards.name: Marsh Refinery
cards.text: [action][action]: Draw 4 cards. (Limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action][action]：抽取4張卡牌。(每場遊戲限制一次)。

cards.name: Gilman House
cards.text: [action]: Heal 2 damage or 2 horror (or any combination thereof). (Limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：治癒2點傷害，或2點恐懼，或1點傷害及1點恐懼。(每場遊戲限制一次)。

cards.name: Innsmouth Square
cards.text: [action]: Resign. You decide to lay low for a while. [fast] Spend 2 resources: Move. Move to a connecting [[Innsmouth]] location.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。你決定蟄伏一段時間。 [free]花費2資源：移動。移動到一個連接的[[印斯茅斯]]地點。

cards.name: Innsmouth Harbour
cards.text: Forced - After you successfully investigate Innsmouth Harbour by 3 or more: Look at the top card of the Leads deck. Then, shuffle the Leads deck. (Group limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你成功調查印斯茅斯港口且高於難度至少3點後：查看跡象牌堆頂的卡牌。然後，混洗跡象牌堆。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: First National Grocery
cards.text: [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an [[Item]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：查找你牌堆頂的6張卡牌，找出1張[[道具]]卡牌加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌堆。(每場遊戲限制一次)。

cards.name: Fish Street Bridge
cards.text: [action][action]: Gain 4 resources. (Limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action][action]：獲得4資源。(每場遊戲限制一次)。

cards.name: The Little Bookshop
cards.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating The Little Bookshop: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the Leads deck.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 調查小利透書店時，在你技能檢定失敗後：將遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌洗入跡象牌堆。

cards.name: Esoteric Order of Dagon
cards.text: Revelation - Put Esoteric Order of Dagon into play. Forced - After the last remaining clue is discovered from Esoteric Order of Dagon: Remove the top card of the Leads deck from the game (without looking at it).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將達貢密教放置入場。 強制 - 在達貢密教上最後的線索被發現後：將跡象牌堆頂的卡牌從遊戲中移除(不要查看)。

cards.name: Sawbone Alley
cards.text: Revelation - Put Sawbone Alley into play. Each [[Humanoid]] enemy at Sawbone Alley gets +2 fight and -2 evade.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將鋸骨巷放置入場。 每個鋸骨巷的[[類人]]敵人得到+2攻擊和-2躲避。“

cards.name: Shoreward Slums
cards.text: Revelation - Put Shoreward Slums into play. Shoreward Slums gets -2 shroud for each doom on it. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Shoreward Slums: Place 1 doom on it.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將朝岸貧民窟放置入場。 朝岸貧民窟上每有一個毀滅標記，其得到隱藏值-2。 強制 - 調查朝岸貧民窟時，在你技能檢定失敗後：在其上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: The House on Water Street
cards.text: Revelation- Put The House on Water Street into play. Forced - After you successfully investigate The House on Water Street by 3 or more: Either draw the top card of the encounter deck, or shuffle that card into the Leads deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現- 將水街老屋放置入場。 強制 - 在你成功調查水街老屋且高於難度至少3點後：抽取遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌，或將該卡牌混洗入跡象牌堆。

cards.name: Innsmouth Jail
cards.text: Revelation - Put Innsmouth Jail into play. Forced - When you defeat an enemy at Innsmouth Jail: Instead of discarding that enemy, shuffle it into the Leads deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將印斯茅斯監獄放置入場。 強制 - 在你於印斯茅斯監獄擊敗一個敵人時：不棄掉該敵人，改為將其洗入跡象牌堆。

cards.name: New Church Green
cards.text: Revelation - Put New Church Green into play. [action][action] If there are no clues on New Church Green: Look at the top card of the Leads deck. If it does not have Victory X, discard it. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將新格林教堂放置入場。 [action][action]如果新格林教堂上沒有線索：查看跡象牌堆頂的卡牌。如果其沒有勝利X，將其丟棄。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Robert Friendly
cards.text: Revelation - Put Robert Friendly into play at the Innsmouth Harbour, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on him. Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Robert Friendly. Then, if there are no clues on him, add him to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將羅伯特·弗蘭得禮放置入場，放到印斯茅斯港口，帶有1[per_investigator]個線索。 冷漠。 [action]：談判。檢定[agility](2)。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點傷害。如果你檢定成功，控制羅伯特·弗蘭得禮上的1個線索。然後，如果他上面沒有線索，將其加入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Zadok Allen
cards.text: Revelation - Put Zadok Allen into play at the Fish Street Bridge, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on him. Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Zadok Allen. Then, if there are no clues on him, add him to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將扎多克·艾倫放置入場，放到魚街舊橋，帶有1[per_investigator]個線索。 冷漠。 [action]：談判。檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定成功，控制扎多克·艾倫。然後，如果他上面沒有線索，將其加入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Brian Burnham
cards.text: Revelation - Put Brian Burnham into play at the First National Grocery, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on him. Aloof. [action] Discard cards from your hand with at least 3 total skill icons among them: Parley. Take control of 1 of the clues on Brian Burnham. Then, if there are no clues on him, add him to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將布里安·伯納姆放置入場，放到國立第一雜貨舖，帶有1[per_investigator]個線索。 冷漠。 [action]丟棄你手中總計至少3個技能圖標的卡牌：談判。控制布里安·伯納姆上的1個線索。然後，如果他上面沒有線索，將其加入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Barnabas Marsh
cards.text: Revelation - Put Barnabas Marsh into play at the Marsh Refinery, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on him. Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, take 1 horror. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Barnabas Marsh. Then, if there are no clues on him, add him to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將巴納巴斯·馬什放置入場，放到馬什精煉廠，帶有1[per_investigator]個線索。 冷漠。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](2)。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點恐懼。如果你檢定成功，控制巴納巴斯·馬什上的1個線索。然後，如果他上面沒有線索，將其加入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Joyce Little
cards.text: Revelation - Put Joyce Little into play at The Little Bookshop, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on her. Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Joyce Little. Then, if there are no clues on her, add her to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將喬伊斯·小利透放置入場，放到小利透書店，帶有1[per_investigator]個線索。 冷漠。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，控制喬伊斯·小利透上的1個線索。然後，如果她上面沒有線索，將其加入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Othera Gilman
cards.text: Revelation - Put Othera Gilman into play at the Gilman House, with 1 [per_investigator] clues on her. Aloof. [action] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Take control of 1 of the clues on Othera Gilman. Then, if there are no clues on her, add her to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將歐斯拉·吉爾曼放置入場，放到吉爾曼旅社，帶有1[per_investigator]個線索。 冷漠。 [action]花費3資源：談判。控制歐斯拉·吉爾曼上的1個線索。然後，如果她上面沒有線索，將其加入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Thomas Dawson
cards.text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [combat].
[reaction] After an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, even if that attack was canceled, exhaust Thomas Dawson: That investigator draws 1 card.
cards.text_cn:
你得到+1[willpower]和+1[combat]。
[reaction]在敵人攻擊你所在地點的調查員後(即便該攻擊被取消)，消耗托馬斯·道森：該調查員抽取1張卡牌。

cards.name: Elina Harper
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
The first action you perform each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.text_cn:
你得到+1[intellect]和+1[agility]。
你每回合執行的第一個行動不引起趁亂攻擊。

cards.name: Priest of Dagon
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - When Priest of Dagon would be defeated or evaded, if there is no doom on it: Instead, heal all damage from it, ready it, and place 1 doom on it. Forced - At the end of the round, if Priest of Dagon is ready and there is no doom on it: Place 1 doom on it.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意無人地點。 強制 - 在達貢祭司將要被擊敗或躲避時，如果其上沒有毀滅標記：改為治癒其全部傷害，將其準備，並在它上面放置1個毀滅標記。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果達貢祭司已準備且上面沒有毀滅標記：在它上面放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Initiate of Dagon
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location. While Initiate of Dagon has no doom on it, it gets +2 fight and +2 evade. Forced - At the end of the round, if Initiate of Dagon is ready and there is no doom on it: Place 1 doom on it.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意無人地點。 達貢新信徒沒有毀滅標記時，其得到+2攻擊和+2躲避。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果達貢新信徒已準備且上面沒有毀滅標記：在它上面放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Lloigor
cards.text: Prey - Fewest cards in hand. Aloof. Hunter. While an investigator at Lloigor's location has no cards in hand, Lloigor loses aloof. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each investigator at Lloigor's location or a connecting location discards 1 random card from their hand.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 手牌最少的目標。 冷漠。獵手。 洛依高爾所在地點的調查員沒有手牌時，洛依高爾失去冷漠。 強制 - 當敵軍階段結束時：洛依高爾所在地點和連接地點的每位調查員隨機丟棄1張手牌。

cards.name: Psychic Pull
cards.text: Revelation - If you have no cards in your hand, Psychic Pull gains surge. Otherwise, discard 1 random card from your hand. Then, test [willpower] (X), where X is the printed cost of the discarded card. If you fail, lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你沒有手牌，魂牽夢繞獲得湧動。否則，隨機丟棄你1張手牌。然後，檢定[willpower](X)，其中X為棄掉卡牌的打印費用。如果你檢定失敗，失去一次行動。

cards.name: Deep One Bull
cards.text: Forced - After Deep One Bull engages you: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. Forced - After an investigator defeats another [[Deep One]] enemy at any location: Ready Deep One Bull and move it once toward that investigator's location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在深潛者巨怪與你交戰後：選擇並丟棄你1張手牌。 強制 - 在位於任意地點的調查員擊敗另一個[[深潛者]]敵人敵人後：準備深潛者巨怪並將其朝該調查員的地點移動一次。

cards.name: Lurking Deep One
cards.text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Forced - After Lurking Deep One engages you: Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - [agility]最低的目標。 強制 - 在潛伏的深潛者與你交戰後：受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Deep One Assault
cards.text: Revelation - Disengage from each [[Deep One]] enemy at your location. Each [[Deep One]] enemy at your location and each connecting location engages you. If no enemies engage you from this effect, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Deep One]] enemy, spawn it engaged with you, and shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 與你所在地點的每個[[深潛者]]敵人解除交戰。你所在地點和連接地點的每個[[深潛者]]敵人與你交戰。如果沒有敵人以此方式與你交戰，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出1個[[深潛者]]敵人，將其生成並與你交戰，混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Undertow
cards.text: Revelation - If your location is unflooded, Undertow gains surge. Otherwise, put Undertow into play in your threat area. Forced - After you move: Take 2 damage and 2 horror. Discard Undertow. [fast] Discard 1 card from your hand: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3) to fight the pull of the tides. If you succeed, discard Undertow.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你所在地點未淹沒，暗流湧動獲得湧動。否則，將暗流湧動放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 在你移動後：受到2點傷害和2點恐懼。丟棄暗流湧動。 [free]丟棄你1張手牌：檢定[combat](3)或[agility](3)以在潮水中掙扎。如果你檢定成功，丟棄暗流湧動。

cards.name: Rising Tides
cards.text: Revelation - Increase the flood level of the nearest location that can have its flood level increased. If no location's flood level is increased by this effect, Rising Tides gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 在能提升淹沒等級的地點中，提升最近的地點的淹沒等級。如果沒有地點的淹沒等級因此效果提升，潮起獲得湧動。

cards.name: Riptide
cards.text: Revelation - If your location is unflooded, Riptide gains surge. Otherwise, test [agility] (3) (4 instead if your location is fully flooded). If you fail, choose and discard 1 asset you control. If you cannot, lose 1 resource for each point you fail by instead.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你所在地點未淹沒，激流獲得湧動。否則，檢定[agility](3)(如果你所在地點完全淹沒，難度改為4)。如果你檢定失敗，選擇並丟棄1個你控制的支援。如果你不能丟棄支援，改為檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，失去1資源。

cards.name: Winged One
cards.text:
Hunter.
X is the shroud value of Winged One's location.
Winged One takes 1 fewer damage from attacks except by [[Ranged]], [[Firearm]], or [[Spell]] cards (to a minimum of 1 damage).
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
X為長翼者所在地點的隱藏值。
除[[遠程]]、[[槍械]]、[[法術]]卡牌外，長翼者每次從攻擊受到的傷害減少1點(最低減至1點)。

cards.name: Fog over Innsmouth
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, either take 1 horror or put Fog over Innsmouth into play next to the agenda deck. If you fail, do both. Each location gets +1 shroud. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Fog over Innsmouth from play. (Max once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，受到1點恐懼，或將印斯茅斯之霧放置入場，放到密謀牌堆旁邊。如果你檢定失敗，執行兩者。 每個地點得到+1隱藏值。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：從場上丟棄1張印斯茅斯之霧。(每輪最多一張。)

cards.name: Macabre Memento
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, you automatically fail. If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你本次技能檢定期間抽出了[cultist]標記，你自動失敗。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Fractured Consciousness
cards.text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). If you reveal a [tablet] token during this test, you automatically fail. If you fail, take 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[intellect](3)。如果你本次技能檢定期間抽出了[tablet]標記，你自動失敗。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點傷害。

cards.name: Memory of Oblivion
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4) or [intellect] (4). If you reveal a [elder_thing] token during this test, you automatically fail. For each point you fail by, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](4)或[intellect](4)。如果你本次技能檢定期間抽出了[elder_thing]標記，你自動失敗。你檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，選擇並丟棄你1張手牌。

cards.name: Malfunction
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Vehicle]] story asset. "[action]" abilities on attached asset cannot be triggered. [action]: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, discard Malfunction.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到最近的[[載具]]劇情支援。 疊加支援上的"[action]"能力不能被觸發。 [action]：檢定[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄機械故障。

cards.name: Tidal Alignment
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - Choose a location where there is at least 1 investigator. Increase that location's flood level. Each investigator at the chosen location takes 1 damage. If the chosen location's flood level is not increased by this effect, Tidal Alignment gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 選擇一個有調查員的地點。提升該地點的淹沒等級。每位在所選地點的調查員受到1點傷害。如果所選地點的淹沒等級未因此效果提升，星潮合相獲得湧動。

cards.name: Syzygy
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Each investigator loses 3 resources. - Each investigator takes 2 horror. - Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance).
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須決定(選擇以下一項)： - 每位調查員失去3資源。 - 每位調查員受到2點恐懼。 - 在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果能導致當前密謀推進)。

cards.name: Underwater Cavern
cards.text: [action]: Move. Move from Underwater Cavern to any flooded [[Cave]] location. Forced - After Underwater Cavern is revealed: It becomes fully flooded.
cards.text_cn: [action]：移動。從水下洞窟移動到任意淹沒的[[洞穴]]地點。 強制 - 在水下洞窟揭示後：其完全淹沒。

cards.name: Tidal Pool
cards.text: Tidal Pool gets +1 shroud while it is partially flooded and +2 shroud while it is fully flooded. Forced - After Tidal Pool is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Tidal Pool without looking at it.
cards.text_cn: 潮池部分淹沒時得到+1隱藏值，完全淹沒時得到+2隱藏值。 強制 - 在潮池揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到潮池上，不要查看。

cards.name: Underground River
cards.text: Underground River cannot be fully flooded. Forced - After Underground River is revealed: Increase its flood level.
cards.text_cn: 地下暗河不能被完全淹沒。 強制 - 在地下暗河揭示後：提升其淹沒等級。

cards.name: Innsmouth Troublemaker
cards.text: Spawn - Location with the most clues. Hunter. [action] Place 1 of your clues on your location: Parley. Exhaust Innsmouth Troublemaker. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase. This ability may be triggered by an investigator at a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 線索最多的地點。 獵手。 [action]將你的1個線索放置在你所在地點：談判。消耗印斯茅斯鬧事者。它在下一個準備階段期間不準備。本能力可以由連接地點的調查員觸發。

cards.name: Innsmouth Look
cards.text: Revelation - Put Innsmouth Look into play in your threat area. You get -1 [intellect] and -1 sanity, and you gain the [[Deep One]] trait. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Innsmouth Look.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將印斯茅斯面容放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 你得到-1[intellect]、-1神智，你獲得[[深潛者]]屬性。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄印斯茅斯面容。

cards.name: Furtive Locals
cards.text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either take 1 damage or put Furtive Locals into play next to the agenda deck. If you fail, do both. Investigators cannot parley. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Furtive Locals from play. (Max once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，受到1點傷害，或將鬼祟的當地人放置入場，放到密謀牌堆旁邊。如果你檢定失敗，執行兩者。 調查員不能談判。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：從場上丟棄1張鬼祟的當地人。(每輪最多一張。)

cards.name: In Too Deep
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 for each location to the east of your location (on the same row).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, move to the connecting location to the east, ignoring all barriers.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, choose a connecting location with no barriers between it and your location. Place 1 barrier between the two locations.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the number of barriers between your location and all connecting locations.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：你同一行東面每有一個地點，-1。
[cultist]：-2。如果你檢定失敗，移動到你東面的連接地點，忽略所有屏障。
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗，選擇一個與你所在地點之間沒有屏障的連接地點。在該地點與你所在地點之間放置1個屏障。
[elder_thing]：-X。X為你所在地點和所有連接地點之間的屏障數量。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 for each location to the east of your location (on the same row).
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, move to the connecting location to the east, ignoring all barriers.
[tablet]: -5. If you fail, choose a connecting location with no barriers between it and your location. Place 1 barrier between the two locations.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is twice the number of barriers between your location and all connecting locations.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：你同一行東面每有一個地點，-2。
[cultist]：-4。如果你檢定失敗，移動到你東面的連接地點，忽略所有屏障。
[tablet]：-5。如果你檢定失敗，選擇一個與你所在地點之間沒有屏障的連接地點。在該地點與你所在地點之間放置1個屏障。
[elder_thing]：-X。X為你所在地點和所有連接地點之間的屏障數量的兩倍。

cards.name: Barricaded Streets
cards.text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[嫌犯]]敵人失去冷漠且不能與之談判。 強制 - 在你回合結束時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點：受到1點傷害。
cards.back_text:
Increase the flood level of each [[Coastal]] location.
Shuffle each set-aside Ravager from the Deep and Young Deep One enemy into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn:
提升每個[[海岸]]地點的淹沒等級。
將每張放在一邊的深海劫掠者、年幼的深潛者敵人和遭遇棄牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Relentless Tide
cards.text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[嫌犯]]敵人失去冷漠且不能與之談判。 強制 - 在你回合結束時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點：受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。
cards.back_text:
Increase the flood level of each [[Midtown]] location.
Spawn the set-aside Angry Mob at Innsmouth Square. Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Angry Mob without looking at it.
cards.back_text_cn:
提升每個[[城中]]地點的淹沒等級。
將放在一邊的憤怒暴民生成在印斯茅斯廣場。從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到憤怒暴民上，不要查看。

cards.name: Flooded Streets
cards.text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage, 1 horror, and discard 1 card at random from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[嫌犯]]敵人失去冷漠且不能與之談判。 強制 - 在你回合結束時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點：受到1點傷害和1點恐懼，並隨機丟棄你1張手牌。
cards.back_text:
Increase the flood level of each location.
In player order, each investigator draws 1 encounter card.
cards.back_text_cn:
提升每個地點的淹沒等級。
按玩家順序，每位調查員抽取1張遭遇卡。

cards.name: Rage of the Deep
cards.text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy loses aloof and cannot be parleyed with. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at a fully flooded location: Take 1 damage, 1 horror, and discard 2 cards at random from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[嫌犯]]敵人失去冷漠且不能與之談判。 強制 - 在你回合結束時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點：受到1點傷害和1點恐懼，並隨機丟棄你2張手牌。
cards.back_text: In your Campaign Log, record Innsmouth was consumed by the rising tide. Each investigator that has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
cards.back_text_cn: 在冒險日誌中，記錄下印斯茅斯被怒潮吞沒。 每位沒有撤退的調查員被擊敗並受到1點肉體創傷。

cards.name: Through the Labyrinth
cards.text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] +1 clues, as a group: Remove 1 barrier between your location and a connecting location. Objective - Get to the Railroad Station! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: [free]以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]+1個線索：移除你所在地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。 目標 - 到達火車站！如果每位倖存的調查員都已撤退，推進場景。
cards.back_text: In your Campaign Log, record the investigators made it safely to their vehicles. (→R1)
cards.back_text_cn: 在冒險日誌中，記錄下調查員安全爬上載具。 (→結局1)

cards.name: Esoteric Order of Dagon
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [action][action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到本地點上，不要查看。 [action][action]：談判。檢定[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: Sawbone Alley
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (1 [per_investigator]). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location. [fast] If the investigators control 7 keys, as a group: Parley. Read Flashback VII in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](1[per_investigator])。如果你檢定成功，移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。 [free]如果調查員以團隊為單位，控制了7個鑰匙：談判。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回VII。

cards.name: Shoreward Slums
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [fast] Take 1 damage: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到本地點上，不要查看。 [free]受到1點傷害：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: The House on Water Street
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [fast] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到本地點上，不要查看。 [free]選擇並丟棄你1張手牌：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: Innsmouth Jail
cards.text: [action] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location. [fast] If you control the black key: Parley. Read Flashback VIII in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費3資源：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。 [free]如果你控制黑色鑰匙：談判。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回VIII。

cards.name: New Church Green
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [action] If there are no clues on this location: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到本地點上，不要查看。 [action]如果本地點沒有線索：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: The Little Bookshop
cards.text: [action][action] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location. [fast] If the investigators control 5 or more keys, as a group: Parley. Read Flashback VI in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: [action][action]抽取遭遇牌堆頂的卡牌：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。 [free]如果調查員以團隊為單位，控制了至少5個鑰匙：談判。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回VI。

cards.name: Fish Street Bridge
cards.text: Fish Street Bridge gets +1 shroud for each barrier between it and any connecting location. [action] Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 魚街舊橋與任意連接地點之間每有一個屏障，其得到+1隱藏值。 [action]在混亂袋裡加入2個[curse]標記：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: First National Grocery
cards.text: Forced - After you enter this location from a connecting location: Place 1 barrier between both locations. [action]: Parley. Test your lowest skill (2). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你從連接地點進入本地點後：在該地點與你所在地點之間放置1個屏障。 [action]：談判。檢定你最低的技能值(2)。如果你檢定成功，移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: Innsmouth Harbour
cards.text: [reaction] After you enter this location: Move to The House on Water Street. [action][action]: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你進入本地點後：移動到水街老屋。 [action][action]：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: Innsmouth Square
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Spawn the set-aside Innsmouth Shoggoth at this location, exhausted. [action]: Parley. Move 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location so it is between this location and a different connecting location. [fast] If the investigators control 2 or more keys, as a group: Parley. Read Flashback V in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點揭示後：將放在一邊的印斯茅斯修格斯以消耗狀態生成在本地點。 [action]：談判。將本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障，移動到本地點和另一個不同連接地點之間。 [free]如果調查員以團隊為單位，控制了至少2個鑰匙：談判。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回V。

cards.name: Gilman House
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on this location without looking at it. [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (2) or [agility] (2). If you succeed, remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到本地點上，不要查看。 [action]：談判。檢定[combat](2)或[agility](2)。如果你檢定成功，移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: Marsh Refinery
cards.text: [fast] If you control 1 or more keys: Move to a connecting location. [action] Discard an asset you control: Parley. Remove 1 barrier between this location and a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: [free]如果你控制鑰匙：移動到一個連接地點。 [action]丟棄一個你控制的支援：談判。移除本地點和連接地點之間的1個屏障。

cards.name: Railroad Station
cards.text: Forced - After you enter this location, if it is flooded: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage. [action]: Resign. You escape the submerged town.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入本地點後，如果其已淹沒：檢定[agility](2)。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點傷害。 [action]：撤退。你逃離了這座被淹沒的村鎮。

cards.name: Desolate Coastline
cards.text: Card effects cannot place barriers between Desolate Coastline and connecting locations.
cards.text_cn: 卡牌效果不能在荒蕪海岸與其連接地點之間放置屏障。

cards.name: Innsmouth Shoggoth
cards.text: Hunter. Massive. Innsmouth Shoggoth gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When Innsmouth Shoggoth moves via its hunter keyword, it ignores all barriers. Forced - After Innsmouth Shoggoth moves: Remove each barrier it moved through.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。龐大。 印斯茅斯修格斯得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 在印斯茅斯修格斯通過其獵手關鍵詞移動時，其忽略所有的屏障。 強制 - 在印斯茅斯修格斯移動後：移除其移動通過的所有屏障。

cards.name: Ravager from the Deep
cards.text: Hunter. While its location is flooded, Ravager from the Deep gets +1 fight and +1 evade (+2 fight and +2 evade instead if its location is fully flooded). Forced - After Ravager from the Deep engages you: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, place 1 barrier between your location and the connecting location to the west.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 深海劫掠者所在地點淹沒時，其得到+1攻擊和+1躲避(如果所在地點完全淹沒，則改為+2攻擊和+2躲避)。 強制 - 在深海劫掠者與你交戰後：檢定[combat](2)。如果你檢定失敗，在你所在地點和西面的連接地點之間放置1個屏障。

cards.name: Emerging Deep One
cards.text: Hunter. Revelation - Emerging Deep One enters play exhausted and unengaged unless its location is fully flooded. Forced - After Emerging Deep One engages you, if your location is flooded: It attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 顯現 - 突現的深潛者以消耗狀態入場且不與調查員交戰，除非其地點完全淹沒。 強制 - 在突現的深潛者與你交戰後，如果你所在地點已淹沒：其攻擊你。

cards.name: Deep One Invasion
cards.text: Revelation - Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. For each location to the east of your location (on the same row), discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Deep One]] enemy with the hunter keyword is discarded and spawn that enemy at that location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將遭遇棄牌堆混洗入遭遇牌堆。你所在地點同一行東面每有一個地點，從遭遇牌堆棄牌，直到棄掉一個帶有獵手關鍵詞的[[深潛者]]敵人，將該敵人生成在該地點。

cards.name: Pulled Back
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, move to the connecting location to the east, ignoring all barriers. Then place each key you control on your location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定失敗，移動到你東面的連接地點，忽略所有屏障。然後將你控制的每個鑰匙放在你所在地點。

cards.name: Inundated
cards.text: Revelation - Place 1 barrier between this location and each connecting location with no barriers between them. If no barriers are placed by this effect, Inundated gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 在本地點和每個連接地點之間放置1個屏障(已有屏障則不放置)。如果本效果沒有放置屏障，氾濫獲得湧動。

cards.name: Joe Sargent
cards.text: Uses (3 tickets). Forced - When Joe Sargent leaves play: Remove him from the game. [fast] Spend 1 ticket: Move to a connecting location that is not fully flooded.
cards.text_cn: 使用(3車票)。 強制 - 在喬·薩金特離場時：將其從遊戲中移除。 [free]花費1車票：移動到一個未完全淹沒的連接地點。

cards.name: Teachings of the Order
cards.text:
Permanent.
[fast] Exhaust Teachings of the Order and choose one effect you have not yet chosen this campaign:
- Remove all [curse] tokens from the chaos bag.
- Remove a flood token from a non-[[Sanctum]] location.
- Defeat a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
cards.text_cn:
永久。
[free]消耗密教教義並選擇以下你未在本次劇本中選過的一項：
- 從混亂袋中移除所有的[curse]標記。
- 移除一個非[[聖堂]]地點的淹沒標記。
- 擊敗一個你所在地點的非[[精英]]敵人。

cards.name: Devil Reef
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of keys the investigators control.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt against a [[Deep One]] enemy, it engages you. (If it is already engaged with you, it disengages first, then re-engages you.)
[tablet]: -3. If you fail and you are not in a vehicle, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail and your location has a key on it, take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。X為調查員控制的鑰匙數量。
[cultist]：-2。如果你檢定失敗且本次檢定為攻擊或嘗試躲避[[深潛者]]敵人，其與你交戰。(如果它已經與你交戰，則其先與你解除交戰，然後再次與你交戰。)
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗且不在載具上，受到1點傷害。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你檢定失敗且你所在地點有鑰匙，受到1點恐懼。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of keys the investigators control.
[cultist]: -3. If this is an attack or evasion attempt against a [[Deep One]] enemy, it engages you. (If it is already engaged with you, it disengages first, then re-engages you.)
[tablet]: -4. If you are not in a vehicle, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -5. If your location has a key on it, take 1 horror.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。X為調查員控制的鑰匙數量+1。
[cultist]：-3。如果本次檢定為攻擊或嘗試躲避[[深潛者]]敵人，其與你交戰。(如果它已經與你交戰，則其先與你解除交戰，然後再次與你交戰。)
[tablet]：-4。如果你不在載具上，受到1點傷害。
[elder_thing]：-5。如果你所在地點有鑰匙，受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Secrets of the Sea (v. I)
cards.text: As an additional cost for you to move from one [[Ocean]] location to another while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded location, partially flooded location, or a vehicle during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 你不在載具上時，作為在[[海洋]]地點間移動的額外費用，你必須花費2行動。 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過載具、未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。

cards.name: Secrets of the Sea (v. II)
cards.text: As an additional cost for you to move from one [[Ocean]] location to another while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded location, partially flooded location, or a vehicle during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 你不在載具上時，作為在[[海洋]]地點間移動的額外費用，你必須花費2行動。 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過載具、未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。

cards.name: The Devil of the Depths
cards.text: As an additional cost for you to move from one [[Ocean]] location to another while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded location, partially flooded location, or a vehicle during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 你不在載具上時，作為在[[海洋]]地點間移動的額外費用，你必須花費2行動。 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過載具、未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: Record in your Campaign Log the tide has grown stronger. (→R1)
cards.back_text_cn: 在冒險日誌中，記錄浪潮愈烈。 (→結局1)

cards.name: Reef of Mysteries
cards.text: Keys can only be claimed from [[Y'ha-nthlei]] locations using the [fast] ability on those locations. Objective - Find and claim as many of the following keys as you can from [[Y'ha-nthlei]] locations (purple, white, and black). If you control all 3 of these keys, advance.
cards.text_cn: [[伊哈·恩斯雷]]地點地點的鑰匙只能通過其地點的[free]能力獲取。 目標 - 儘可能多地從[[伊哈·恩斯雷]]地點找到並獲取下列鑰匙(紫色、白色和黑色)。如果你控制全部3把這些鑰匙，推進場景。

cards.name: Churning Waters
cards.text: [action] If you are in the Fishing Vessel: Resign. Each investigator in the Fishing Vessel resigns. Remove Fishing Vessel from the game. Each resigning investigator places each of their purple, black, or white keys on the current act. All other investigators are left to fend for themselves.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你在漁船上：撤退。漁船上的每位調查員撤退。將漁船從遊戲中移除。每位撤退的調查員將其紫色、黑色或白色鑰匙放在當前場景上。所有其他調查員被拋下，自力更生。
cards.back_text: Churning Waters enters play fully flooded (even while it is unrevealed).
cards.back_text_cn: 急渦水域以完全淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Lonely Isle
cards.text: Forced - After Lonely Isle is revealed: Put 2 random set-aside Tidal Tunnels into play, each adjacent to Lonely Isle (but not to one another).
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在孤島揭示後：將隨機2張放在一邊的潮水通道放置入場，各與孤島相鄰(但這兩張卡牌彼此不相鄰).

cards.name: Hidden Cove
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal Hidden Cove: Put 1 set-aside Tidal Tunnel into play adjacent to Hidden Cove, then put 1 set-aside Unfathomable Depths into play adjacent to that Tidal Tunnel.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你揭示隱蔽海灣後：將1張放在一邊的潮水通道放置入場，與隱蔽海灣相鄰，然後將1張放在一邊的無常深淵放置入場，與該潮水通道相鄰。

cards.name: Waveworn Island
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal Waveworn Island: Increase its flood level. Put 1 random set-aside Unfathomable Depths and 2 random set-aside Tidal Tunnels into play, each adjacent to Waveworn Island (but not to one another).
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你揭示浪蝕小島後：提升其淹沒等級。將隨機1張放在一邊的無常深淵隨機2張放在一邊的潮水通道放置入場，各與浪蝕小島相鄰(但這三張卡牌彼此不相鄰)。

cards.name: Salt Marshes
cards.text: [action] If you control the purple key: Look at the revealed side of any Tidal Tunnels or Unfathomable Depths location in play. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After you reveal Salt Marshes: Increase its flood level. Put 1 random set-aside Tidal Tunnel into play adjacent to Salt Marshes.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制紫色鑰匙：查看場上任意潮水通道或無常深淵地點的已揭示面。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。) 強制 - 在你揭示鹽沼後：提升其淹沒等級。將隨機1張放在一邊的潮水通道放置入場，與鹽沼相鄰。

cards.name: Black Reef

cards.name: Fishing Vessel
cards.text:
Vehicle.
While you are in this vehicle, treat your location as if it were unflooded.
[action]: Move Fishing Vessel to a connecting [[Ocean]] location.
cards.text_cn:
載具.
你在本載具時，將你的地點視為如同未淹沒。
[action]：將漁船移動到一個連接的[[海洋]]地點。

cards.name: Waveworn Idol
cards.text: [reaction] After your location's flood level changes, or after a [[Deep One]] enemy spawns at your location, exhaust Waveworn Idol: Immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你所在地點的淹沒等級變化後，或在[[深潛者]]敵人生成在你所在地點後，消耗浪蝕偶像：立即進行一次行動，如同在你的回合(該行動不計入你每回合可以進行的行動數量)。

cards.name: Awakened Mantle
cards.text: [fast] If your location is flooded, exhaust Awakened Mantle: Move to a connecting location that is also flooded.
cards.text_cn: [free] 如果你所在地點已淹沒，消耗覺醒斗篷：移動到一個淹沒的連接地點。

cards.name: Headdress of Y'ha-nthlei
cards.text: You get +1 skill value while investigating a flooded location or while attacking or evading an enemy at a flooded location.
cards.text_cn: 你調查淹沒地點時，以及攻擊或躲避在淹沒地點的敵人時，得到技能值+1。

cards.name: Deep One Predator
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - After Deep One Predator engages you: Move 1 of your clues or keys to Deep One Predator. Forced - When you defeat or evade Deep One Predator: Take control of all of its clues and keys.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 在掠食的深潛者與你交戰後：將你的1個線索或鑰匙移動到掠食的深潛者上。 強制 - 在你擊敗或躲避掠食的深潛者時：控制其所有的線索和鑰匙。

cards.name: Hunting Deep One
cards.text: Hunter. While Hunting Deep One is engaged with you, you cannot enter vehicles or gain resources. Forced - After Hunting Deep One engages you: If you are not in a vehicle, lose 2 resources. If you are in a vehicle, leave your vehicle.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 追獵的深潛者與你交戰時，你不能進入載具或獲得資源。 強制 - 在追獵的深潛者與你交戰後：如果你不在載具上，失去2資源。如果你在載具上，離開你的載具。

cards.name: Shapes in the Water
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, take 2 horror. This test gets +1 difficulty if your location is flooded (+2 difficulty instead if it is fully flooded).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點恐懼。如果你所在地點已淹沒，本次檢定難度+1(如果你所在地點完全淹沒，改為難度+2)。

cards.name: Aquatic Ambush
cards.text: Revelation - Put Aquatic Ambush into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - When you reveal a chaos token while attacking an enemy at a flooded location: Reveal an additional chaos token. (Max once per test.) Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Aquatic Ambush from play. (Max once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將伏兵出水放置入場，放到密謀牌堆旁邊。 強制 - 只要你攻擊淹沒地點的敵人，在你抽取混亂標記時：再抽出一個混亂標記。(每次檢定最多一次。) 強制 - 當一輪結束時：從場上丟棄1張伏兵出水。(每輪最多一張。)

cards.name: Horrors from the Deep
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 2 damage. This test gets +1 difficulty if your location is flooded (+2 difficulty instead if it is fully flooded).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](2)。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點傷害。如果你所在地點已淹沒，本次檢定難度+1(如果你所在地點完全淹沒，改為難度+2)。

cards.name: Stowaway
cards.text: Revelation - If no investigators are in a vehicle, Stowaway gains surge. Otherwise, each investigator in a vehicle must either take 1 damage and 1 horror or leave that vehicle. Each investigator who left a vehicle cannot enter that vehicle for the remainder of the round.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果沒有調查員在載具上，偷偷上船獲得湧動。否則，每位調查員載具上的調查員必須受到1點傷害和1點恐懼，或離開該載具。每位離開載具的調查員該輪不能再進入該載具。

cards.name: Dragged Under
cards.text: Revelation - Put Dragged Under into play in your threat area. If you are in a vehicle, leave it. You cannot enter vehicles. [action]: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Dragged Under.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將拖入水底放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。如果你在載具上，離開該載具。 你不能進入載具。 [action]：檢定[combat](3)或[agility](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄拖入水底。

cards.name: The Chase is On! (v. I)
cards.text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.
cards.text_cn: 你不在載具上時，作為移動的額外費用，你必須花費2行動。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：從最後方的地點開始，將每個沒有載具，敵人和調查員的地點放在一邊，位於場外(如果其有勝利X且沒有線索，則將其放入勝利牌區)。在到達有載具、敵人或調查員的地點時；或在最後方的調查員後方一個地點停下。

將每個正在運行的載具翻面，使其停止。

cards.text_cn: 每個敵人獲得獵手。 強制 - 當每個調查階段結束時：每個運行的載具必須在其司機的選擇移動到一個連接的[[道路]]地點。 目標 - 盡快開到獵鷹岬！(在你得到指示時推進場景。)

cards.text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Falcon Point Approach, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果所有未被擊敗的調查員均在獵鷹岬通路，推進場景。

cards.text: Road 1. Forced - When a vehicle leaves this location: Investigators at this location, as a group, must spend 1 clue for each investigator in that vehicle. For each clue they could not spend, an investigator in that vehicle takes 2 damage. (Limit once per game for each vehicle.)
cards.text_cn: 道路1。 強制 - 在有載具離開本地點時：該載具上每有一位調查員，該地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位，花費1個線索。每有一個線索不能花費，該載具上的一位調查員必須受到2點傷害。(每個載具每場遊戲限制1次。)

cards.name: Tight Turn
cards.text: Road 1. Forced - When a vehicle leaves this location: Investigators at this location, as a group, must spend 2 clues for each investigator in that vehicle. For each clue they could not spend, an investigator in that vehicle takes 1 damage. (Limit once per game for each vehicle.)
cards.text_cn: 道路1。 強制 - 在有載具離開本地點時：該載具上每有一位調查員，該地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位，花費2個線索。每有一個線索不能花費，該載具上的一位調查員必須受到1點傷害。(每個載具每場遊戲限制1次。)

cards.text: Road 1. Forced - When a vehicle leaves this location: Investigators at this location, as a group, must spend 2 clues for each investigator in that vehicle. For each clue they could not spend, an investigator in that vehicle takes 2 damage. (Limit once per game for each vehicle.)
cards.text_cn: 道路1。 強制 - 在有載具離開本地點時：該載具上每有一位調查員，該地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位，花費2個線索。每有一個線索不能花費，該載具上的一位調查員必須受到2點傷害。(每個載具每場遊戲限制1次。)

cards.name: Desolate Road
cards.text: Road 1. Forced - When a vehicle leaves this location: Investigators at this location, as a group, must spend 2 clues for each investigator in that vehicle. If they cannot, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] enemy is discarded and spawn that enemy at Desolate Road. (Limit once per game for each vehicle.)
cards.text_cn: 道路1。 強制 - 在有載具離開本地點時：該載具上每有一位調查員，該地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位，花費2個線索。如果其不能，從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到棄掉一個[[載具]]敵人，將其生成在荒涼道路。(每個載具每場遊戲限制1次。)

cards.name: Desolate Road
cards.text: Road 1. Forced - When a vehicle leaves this location: Investigators at this location, as a group, must spend 1 clue for each investigator in that vehicle. If they cannot, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] enemy is discarded and spawn that enemy at Desolate Road. (Limit once per game for each vehicle.)
cards.text_cn: 道路1。 強制 - 在有載具離開本地點時：該載具上每有一位調查員，該地點的調查員必須以團隊為單位，花費1個線索。如果其不能，從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到棄掉一個[[載具]]敵人，將其生成在荒涼道路。(每個載具每場遊戲限制1次。)

cards.name: Long Way Around
cards.text: Road 1. Forced - After a vehicle enters Long Way Around: Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this may cause the current agenda to advance). That vehicle cannot leave Long Way Around until the end of the next round.
cards.text_cn: 道路1。 強制 - 在有載具進入蜿蜒長路後：在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果能導致當前密謀推進)。該載具直到下一輪結束，不能離開蜿蜒長路。

cards.name: Thomas Dawson's Car
cards.text:
Vehicle. Limit 2 investigators in this vehicle.
This vehicle is running. Investigators cannot enter or leave it.
[action] If you are this vehicle's driver: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, move this vehicle to a connecting [[Road]] location. (Max once per round.)
[action] If you are this vehicle's driver: You stop the car. Flip this vehicle over.
cards.text_cn:
載具。本載具上僅限2位調查員。
本載具正在運行。調查員不能進入或離開本載具。
[action]如果你是本載具的司機：抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。然後，將本載具移動到一個連接的[[道路]]地點。(每輪最多一次。)
[action]如果你是本載具的司機：你把車停下。將本載具翻面。

cards.name: Elina Harper's Car
cards.text:
Vehicle. Limit 2 investigators in this vehicle.
This vehicle is running. Investigators cannot enter or leave it.
[action] If you are this vehicle's driver: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, move this vehicle to a connecting [[Road]] location. (Max once per round.)
[action] If you are this vehicle's driver: You stop the car. Flip this vehicle over.
cards.text_cn:
載具。本載具上僅限2位調查員。
本載具正在運行。調查員不能進入或離開本載具。
[action]如果你是本載具的司機：抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。然後，將本載具移動到一個連接的[[道路]]地點。(每輪最多一次。)
[action]如果你是本載具的司機：你把車停下。將本載具翻面。

cards.name: Pursuing Motorcar
cards.text: Spawn - Rearmost location. Hunter. Forced - When Pursuing Motorcar attacks you, if you are not in a vehicle: It deals +2 damage for this attack. Forced - When Pursuing Motorcar attacks an investigator in a vehicle: It attacks each other investigator in that vehicle, as well.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 最後方的地點。 獵手。 強制 - 在追擊快車攻擊你時，如果你不在載具上：本次攻擊造成+2傷害。 強制 - 在追擊快車攻擊載具上的調查員時：其也攻擊同一載具上的其他每位調查員。

cards.name: Hit Van
cards.text: Spawn - Rearmost location. Hunter. Retaliate. Hit Van cannot attack during the same phase it moved via its hunter keyword.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 最後方的地點。 獵手。反擊。 一車打手在通過其獵手關鍵詞移動的同一階段期間不能攻擊。

cards.name: Hybrid Assassin
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - After Hybrid Assassin moves via its hunter keyword, if it is unengaged: Resolve its hunter keyword again. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 在混血刺客通過其獵手關鍵詞移動後，如果其未與調查員交戰：再次結算其獵手關鍵詞。(每輪限制一次)。

cards.name: Bumpy Ride
cards.text: Revelation - If you are... - ...not in a vehicle, test [agility] (5). If you fail, take 3 damage. - ...in a vehicle, that vehicle's driver tests [agility] (3). If the driver fails, each investigator in your vehicle takes 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你…… - ……不在載具上，檢定[agility](5)。如果你檢定失敗，受到3點傷害。 - ……在載具上，該載具的司機檢定[agility](3)。如果司機檢定失敗，你載具上的每位調查員受到2點傷害。

cards.name: "I can't see!"
cards.text: Revelation - If you are... - ...not in a vehicle, test [willpower] (5). If you fail, take 3 horror. - ...in a vehicle, that vehicle's driver tests [willpower] (3). If the driver fails, each investigator in your vehicle takes 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你…… - ……不在載具上，檢定[willpower](5)。如果你檢定失敗，受到3點恐懼。 - ……在載具上，該載具的司機檢定[willpower](3)。如果司機檢定失敗，你載具上的每位調查員受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Eyes in the Trees
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must either discard an asset you control, or discard 1 card from your hand for each point you failed by. If you fail and you are in a vehicle, each other investigator in your vehicle must also resolve this effect as if they had just failed.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](4)。如果你檢定失敗，你必須丟棄你控制的一個支援，或每低於難度一點丟棄1張手牌。如果你檢定失敗且你在載具上，你載具上的其他每位調查員必須結算該效果，如同其剛剛檢定失敗。

cards.name: "They're catching up!"
cards.text: Revelation - Resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play. If no enemies move as a result of this effect, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] enemy is discarded and spawn that enemy at the rearmost location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 結算場上每個敵人的獵手關鍵詞。如果沒有敵人因此效果移動，從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到棄掉一個[[載具]]敵人，將其生成在最後方的地點。

cards.name: A Light in the Fog
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If your location is flooded, reveal an additional chaos token.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, after this test ends, increase the flood level of your location.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail this test and your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, move the nearest ready unengaged enemy once toward your location. It loses aloof during this movement.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1。如果你所在地點已淹沒，再抽出一個混亂標記。
[cultist]：-2。如果你檢定失敗，本次檢定結束後，提升你所在地點的淹沒等級。
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗且你所在地點已淹沒，受到1點傷害。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你檢定失敗，最近的未與調查員交戰的準備敵人朝你所在地點移動一次。該敵人本次移動期間失去冷漠。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2. If your location is flooded, reveal an additional chaos token.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, after this test ends, increase the flood level of your location (if you cannot, take 1 horror instead).
[tablet]: -3. If you fail this test and your location is flooded, take 2 damage.
[elder_thing]: -4. Move the nearest unengaged enemy once toward your location. It loses aloof during this movement.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2。如果你所在地點已淹沒，再抽出一個混亂標記。
[cultist]：-2。如果你檢定失敗，本次檢定結束後，提升你所在地點的淹沒等級(如果你不能，改為受到1點恐懼)。
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗且你所在地點已淹沒，受到2點傷害。
[elder_thing]：-4。最近的未與調查員交戰的敵人朝你所在地點移動一次。該敵人本次移動期間失去冷漠。

cards.name: Fog on the Bay
cards.text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
cards.text_cn: 同一行的地點相互連接。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時：將上面的所有毀滅標記移動到下一張密謀上。
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy engaged with the lead investigator. Place the set-aside blue key on Oceiros Marsh. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck. Each investigator loses each of their clues. Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell. Advance the act directly to act 2a (do not resolve act 1b).
cards.back_text_cn: 生成放在一邊的奧賽羅思·馬什敵人，與調查員隊長交戰。將放在一邊的藍色鑰匙放在奧賽羅思·馬什上。 將放在一邊的每張進腥盡力混洗入遭遇牌堆。 每位調查員失去其所有線索。 將放在一邊的燈塔地下室地點放置入場，就在燈塔梯井正下方。 直接推進到場景2a(不結算場景1b)。

cards.name: Unchanging as the Sea
cards.text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When an investigator is captured: Advance this agenda. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
cards.text_cn: 同一行的地點相互連接。 強制 - 在有調查員被俘時：推進本密謀。 強制 - 在本密謀推進時：將上面的所有毀滅標記移動到下一張密謀上。
cards.back_text: Each investigator is captured. Place each of their keys on Holding Cells. If Oceiros Marsh is in play, set him aside, out of play. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck. Reveal the Lighthouse Basement. Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.) Advance the act directly to act 3a (do not resolve act 2b).
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員被俘。將其所有鑰匙放在拘禁室。如果奧賽羅思·馬什在場上，將其放在一邊，位於場外。將放在一邊的每張慘遭俘虜混洗入遭遇牌堆。 揭示燈塔地下室。將沉沒岩洞(深層)放置入場，放在沉沒岩洞(淺層)正下方，將沉沒岩洞(底層)放置入場，放在沉沒岩洞(深層)正下方。然後，將放在一邊的潮水通道地點隨機放置入場，直到每一行都有正好4個地點(除燈光室的一行外)。(參見劇本手冊上的圖示。) 直接推進到場景3a(不結算場景2b)。

cards.name: The Tide Rises
cards.text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another.
cards.text_cn: 同一行的地點相互連接。
cards.back_text: Search all out-of-play areas for Oceiros Marsh and spawn him in the Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths). Remove each [[Falcon Point]] location from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them). Move each enemy and investigator at those locations to Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths). Each other card at those locations is discarded. Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels.
cards.back_text_cn: 查找所有場外區域，找出奧賽羅思·馬什，將其生成在沉沒岩洞(淺層)。 將每個[[獵鷹岬]]地點從遊戲中移除(如果其有勝利X且無線索，則將其加入勝利牌區)。將這些地點的所有敵人和調查員移動到沉沒岩洞(淺層)。丟棄這些地點的所有其他卡牌。 在可以提升淹沒等級的地點中，找到最底下4張。提升這些地點的淹沒等級。

cards.name: Terror at Falcon Point
cards.text: Oceiros Marsh gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Locations on the same row are connected to one another. (Beware - the scenario may not end when this agenda advances, but the tide will continue to rise...)
cards.text_cn: 奧賽羅思·馬什得到生命值+2[per_investigator]。 同一行的地點相互連接。 (注意——在本密謀推進時，本場冒險可能不會結束，但浪潮將起……)
cards.back_text: Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels. If you cannot, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, flip this agenda back over and continue playing.
cards.back_text_cn: 在可以提升淹沒等級的地點中，找到最底下4張。提升這些地點的淹沒等級。如果你不能，進入(→結局3)。否則，將本密謀翻面，繼續遊戲。

cards.name: The Lighthouse
cards.text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues before the agenda advances.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 在密謀推進前花費所需數量的線索。
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy in Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage, exhausted. Place the set-aside blue key on him. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b).
cards.back_text_cn: 生成放在一邊的奧賽羅思·馬什敵人以消耗狀態生成在燈塔看門人小屋。將放在一邊的藍色鑰匙放在奧賽羅思·馬什上。 將放在一邊的每張進腥盡力混洗入遭遇牌堆。 將放在一邊的燈塔地下室地點放置入場，放在燈塔梯井正下方。 直接推進到密謀2a(不結算密謀1b)。

cards.name: Finding the Path
cards.text: Objective - If an investigator enters Lighthouse Basement before the agenda advances, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果在密謀推進前，有調查員進入了燈塔地下室，推進場景。
cards.back_text: If Oceiros Marsh is in play, add him to the victory display. Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.) Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
cards.back_text_cn: 如果奧賽羅思·馬什在場上，將其加入勝利牌區。 將沉沒岩洞(深層)放置入場，放在沉沒岩洞(淺層)正下方；將沉沒岩洞(底層)放置入場，放在沉沒岩洞(深層)正下方。然後，將放在一邊的潮水通道地點隨機放置入場，直到每一行都有正好4個地點(除燈光室的一行外)。(參見劇本手冊上的圖示。) 將放在一邊的每張慘遭俘虜混洗入遭遇牌堆。 直接推進到密謀3a(不結算密謀2b)。

cards.name: Worshippers of the Deep
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Each investigator at a fully flooded location must either take 3 damage or move to the location directly below their location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. (Hint - You may wish to find what you came for before you leave this place. The black and red keys represent the objects you need the most.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當調查階段結束時：每位在完全淹沒地點的調查員，必須受到3點傷害，或移動到其正下方的地點。 目標 - 如果每位未被擊敗的調查員都撤退，推進場景。(提示——在離開之前，你可能先想要找到自己來到此處的目的。黑色和紅色鑰匙是你最需要的東西。)
cards.back_text:
If at least 1 investigator resigned from the Moon Room:
The underwater tunnels seem to go on forever, stretching into murk-ridden eddies. Dark salt water crashes against the glass helmet of your suit. After what feels like an eternity, you burst into the cold evening air, chilled to the bone. You pull the heavy suit off, piece by piece, the moment you reach the shore.
(→R1) If each investigator who resigned did so from the Falcon Point Gatehouse:
You flee into the lonely woods, panting for air. Somehow, you've escaped the denizens of the deep once more.
(→R2)
cards.back_text_cn:
如果有調查員從月之室撤退：
水下的隧道似入永恆，直通往黑暗沉沉的渦流。暗黑的鹹水打在你頭盔的玻璃上。彷彿是永恆之後，你終於衝出水面，闖入寒冷的夜空中，渾身凍得骨頭發涼。你來到海岸上後，一件件將沉重的潛水服脫下。
(→結局1) 如果每位調查員都從獵鷹岬門房撤退：
你逃進孤寂的樹林，停下來喘口氣。不知怎的，你又一次從深淵住民的手中逃脫了。
(→結局2)

cards.name: Falcon Point Gatehouse
cards.text: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded. [action]: Resign. You head back into the woods, leaving the lighthouse and its mysteries behind. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act.
cards.text_cn: 獵鷹岬門房不能被完全淹沒。 [action]：撤退。你退回樹林，把燈塔和它的秘密都抛在身後。如果你控制黑色或紅色鑰匙，將你控制的這些鑰匙都放在當前場景上。
cards.back_text: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded.
cards.back_text_cn: 獵鷹岬門房不能被完全淹沒。

cards.name: Lighthouse Stairwell
cards.text:
Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
[fast] If there are any [[Relic]] story assets currently set aside: Add 1 of them to your hand.
cards.text_cn:
燈塔梯井不能被完全淹沒。
[free]如果當前有任意[[遺物]]劇情支援放在一邊：將其中1張加入你的手牌。
cards.back_text: Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
cards.back_text_cn: 燈塔梯井不能被完全淹沒。

cards.name: Lantern Room
cards.text: Lantern Room cannot be flooded. Forced - After Lantern Room is revealed: Place the set-aside white key on it.
cards.text_cn: 燈光室不能被淹沒。 強制 - 在燈光室揭示後：將放在一邊的白色鑰匙放在上面。
cards.back_text: Lantern Room cannot be flooded.
cards.back_text_cn: 燈光室不能被淹沒。

cards.name: Falcon Point Cliffside
cards.text: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded. [fast] If you control the white key: Using the white key, you peer out into the dark, stormy horizon, and something sparks in your memories. Read Flashback XII in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: 獵鷹岬崖邊不能被完全淹沒。 [free] 如果你控制了白色鑰匙：你使用白色鑰匙窺探風暴肆虐的漆黑地平線，記憶中閃過什麼事情。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回XII。
cards.back_text: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded.
cards.back_text_cn: 獵鷹岬崖邊不能被完全淹沒。

cards.name: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage
cards.text: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded. Forced - After Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage is revealed: Place the set-aside yellow key on it.
cards.text_cn: 燈塔看門人小屋不能被完全淹沒。 強制 - 在燈塔看門人小屋揭示後：將放在一邊的黃色鑰匙放在上面。
cards.back_text: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded.
cards.back_text_cn: 燈塔看門人小屋不能被完全淹沒。

cards.name: Sunken Grotto
cards.text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.
cards.text_cn: [free]在本地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：查看所在行的一個潮水通道地點的已揭示面。
cards.back_text: The door leading into the basement of the lighthouse is locked tight. You cannot enter this location unless you control the blue key.
cards.back_text_cn: 通向燈塔地下室的門鎖住了。你不能進入該地點，除非你控制了藍色鑰匙。

cards.name: Sunken Grotto
cards.text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.
cards.text_cn: [free]在本地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：查看所在行的一個潮水通道地點的已揭示面。
