cards.name: Shrine to Hydra
cards.text: Clues cannot be discovered from Shrine to Hydra except by investigating. While an investigator at Shrine to Hydra controls the green key, Shrine to Hydra gets -3 shroud. Forced - After Shrine to Hydra is revealed: Place the set-aside red key on it.
cards.text_cn: 除調查外，不能從海德拉祭壇發現線索。 海德拉祭壇的調查員控制綠色鑰匙時，海德拉祭壇得到-3隱藏值。 強制 - 在海德拉祭壇揭示後：將放在一邊的紅色鑰匙放在上面。

cards.name: Deep One Nursery
cards.text: [fast] If you control the purple key: You compare the purple key to the oversized eggs littering the flooded chamber and recall something. Read Flashback XIII in the Campaign Guide. Forced - After Deep One Nursery is revealed: Increase its flood level.
cards.text_cn: [free]如果你控制紫色鑰匙：你將紫色鑰匙和這個溢水的洞室裡大到誇張的卵進行了一番比較，回想起了什麼。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回XIII。 強制 - 在深潛者溫床揭示後：提升其淹沒等級。

cards.name: The Moon Room
cards.text: [action] If The Moon Room is unflooded: Resign. You don one of the empty diving suits and dive into the reflecting pool. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act. Forced - After The Moon Room is revealed: Increase its flood level.
cards.text_cn: [action] 如果月之室未淹沒：撤退。你穿上一件閒置的潛水服，一頭扎進了反射月光的池中。如果你控制黑色或紅色鑰匙，將你控制的這些鑰匙都放在當前場景上。 強制 - 在月之室揭示後：提升其淹沒等級。

cards.name: Sunken Archives
cards.text: Clues cannot be discovered at Sunken Archives while it is flooded. Forced - After Sunken Archives is revealed: It becomes fully flooded. Place the set-aside black key on it.
cards.text_cn: 沉沒檔案庫淹沒時，不能發現該地點的線索。 強制 - 在沉沒檔案庫揭示後：其完全淹沒。將放在一邊的黑色鑰匙放在上面。

cards.name: Pump Room
cards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) or [agility] (2). If you succeed, choose two locations. Decrease the flood level of one location and increase the flood level of the other (if you succeed by 2 or more, you may instead choose just one location and decrease its flood level).
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[intellect](2)或[agility](2)。如果你檢定成功，選擇兩個地點。降低其中一個地點的淹沒等級，提升其中另一個地點的淹沒等級(如果你檢定成功且超過難度至少2點，你可以改為只選擇一個地點，降低其淹沒等級)。

cards.name: Captured!
cards.text:
The first time an investigator is captured, read the following:
You are bound and dragged deep underground, then thrown into a sealed prison cell, surrounded on all sides by dripping stone walls. Your cries fall on deaf ears as your captor's footsteps fade into the distance.
Remove the captured investigator from their location and return each asset in that investigator's hand slots to their hand. Turn that investigator's mini-card sideways to indicate that they have been captured. Captured investigators cannot move, fight, or be engaged. Flip this story card over to its "Holding Cells" side and put it into play. It is not on any existing row or column, and is only connected to Sunken Grotto locations through its connection icons. Place the captured investigator in Holding Cells. From now on, whenever an investigator is captured, resolve this same effect (return each asset in their hand slots to their hand, turn their mini-card sideways, and place them in Holding Cells).
cards.text_cn:
當第一次有調查員被俘，閱讀下列文本：
你被五花大綁，拖行在深深的地下，然後扔進一間緊鎖的囚室，周圍全是滴水的石牆。抓住你的人腳步聲漸漸遠去，對你的叫喊全都充耳不聞。
將被俘的調查員從其地點移除，將該調查員每個佔手部槽位的支援返回其手牌。 將該調查員的迷你卡側放，以示其被俘。被俘的調查員不能移動、攻擊，也不能與敵人交戰。 將本劇情卡翻到"拘禁室"面並放置入場。它不存在於任何已有的行或列，只通過連接圖標與沉沒岩洞地點連接。將被俘的調查員放在拘禁室。 從現在起，每當有調查員被俘，結算相同的文本(將其每個佔手部槽位的支援返回手中；側放其迷你卡；將其放到拘禁室)。

cards.name: Oceiros Marsh
cards.text: Hunter. Retaliate. Oceiros Marsh gets +2 evade while his location is flooded. Forced - After Oceiros Marsh is successfully evaded: For each point you succeeded by, take control of 1 key on him. Forced - After Oceiros Marsh attacks you during the enemy phase: You are captured. Place each of your keys on Oceiros Marsh.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。反擊。 奧賽羅思·馬什的地點淹沒時，其得到+2躲避值。 強制 - 在成功躲避奧賽羅思·馬什後：你檢定成功且每超過難度1點，控制他的1個鑰匙。 強制 - 在奧賽羅思·馬什在敵軍階段期間攻擊你後：你被俘虜了。將你的所有鑰匙放在奧賽羅思·馬什上。

cards.name: Deep One Nursemaid
cards.text: Aloof. Retaliate. While Deep One Nursemaid is unengaged, each other [[Deep One]] enemy at its location or connecting locations gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - After Deep One Nursemaid engages you: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card loses surge.
cards.text_cn: 冷漠。反擊。 深潛者保姆未與調查員交戰時，其地點和連接地點的每個其他[[深潛者]]敵人得到+1攻擊和+1躲避。 強制 - 在深潛者保姆與你交戰後：抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。該卡牌失去湧動。

cards.name: Deep One Hatchling
cards.text: Surge. Forced - After you engage Deep One Hatchling: Either lose 1 action or it attacks you. Forced - After you defeat Deep One Hatchling: Move the nearest ready, unengaged [[Deep One]] enemy once toward your location. That enemy loses aloof during this movement.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 強制 - 在深潛者幼體與你交戰後：你必須失去一次行動，或它攻擊你。 強制 - 在你擊敗深潛者幼體後：最近的未與調查員交戰的準備的[[深潛者]]敵人朝你所在地點移動一次。該敵人本次移動期間失去冷漠。

cards.name: Hideous Lullaby
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no [[Deep One]] enemies in play, Hideous Lullaby gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Deep One]] enemy with the highest fight value. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果場上沒有[[深潛者]]敵人，醜惡搖籃曲獲得湧動。否則，找到攻擊值最高的[[深潛者]]敵人。檢定[willpower](X)，其中X為為該敵人的攻擊值。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Kiss of Brine
cards.text: Revelation - Test [combat] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 2 if you are at a flooded location. If you fail, take 1 damage and put Kiss of Brine into play in your threat area. You cannot gain resources or draw cards. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Kiss of Brine.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[combat](2)。如果你在淹沒的地點，本次檢定難度提升2點。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點傷害並將鹹海之吻放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 你不能獲得資源或抽取卡牌。 強制 - 當敵軍階段結束時：丟棄鹹海之吻。

cards.name: Totality
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, put Totality into play in your threat area. Forced - After you enter a flooded location: Take 1 horror. Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard Totality.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定失敗，將全蝕放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 在你進入淹沒的地點後：受到1點恐懼。 強制 - 當你回合結束時：丟棄全蝕。

cards.name: Worth His Salt
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to Oceiros Marsh, even if he is in the victory display. Forced - After Oceiros Marsh moves via his hunter keyword, if he is unengaged: Resolve his hunter keyword again. He cannot attack this phase. (Limit once per round.) Forced - When Oceiros Marsh attacks: This attack deals +1 damage and +1 horror. Discard this card.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到奧賽羅思·馬什，即便他在勝利牌區。 強制 - 在奧賽羅思·馬什通過其獵手關鍵詞移動後，如果他未與調查員交戰：再次結算其獵手關鍵詞。他本階段不能攻擊。(每輪限制一次)。 強制 - 在奧賽羅思·馬什攻擊時：本次攻擊造成+1傷害和+1點恐懼。丟棄本卡牌。

cards.name: Taken Captive
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you are captured; place each of your keys on Holding Cells.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](4)。如果你檢定失敗，你被俘虜，將你的所有鑰匙放在拘禁室。

cards.name: The Lair of Dagon
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 for each key on this card.
[cultist]: 0. Reveal an additional chaos token. If you reveal 1 or more [curse] tokens during this test, you automatically fail.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place each key you control on your location.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：本卡牌上每有一個鑰匙，-1。
[cultist]：0。再抽出一個混亂標記。如果你本次檢定期間抽出了[curse]標記，你自動失敗。
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗，將你控制的所有鑰匙放在你的地點。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你檢定失敗，在混亂袋中加入1個[curse]標記。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 for each key on this card.
[cultist]: -2. Reveal an additional chaos token. If you reveal 1 or more [curse] tokens during this test, you automatically fail.
[tablet]: -3. Place each key you control on your location and take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -4. Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：本卡牌上每有一個鑰匙，-2。
[cultist]：-2。再抽出一個混亂標記。如果你本次檢定期間抽出了[curse]標記，你自動失敗。
[tablet]：-3。將你控制的所有鑰匙放在你的地點並受到1點傷害。
[elder_thing]：-4。在混亂袋中加入2個[curse]標記。

cards.name: The Initiation (v. I)
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. Check Campaign Log. - If a jailbreak is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log, spawn the set-aside [[Suspect]] enemy at a [[Third Floor]] location, or at the Grand Entryway if a [[Third Floor]] location is not in play (ignoring that enemy's revelation ability). Place the set-aside blue key on that enemy. - Otherwise, the lead investigator searches the encounter deck for a [[Cultist]] enemy and spawns it in a connecting location. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 在混亂袋中加入2個[curse]標記。檢查冒險日誌。 - 如果如果冒險日誌中，"恢復記憶"下方，列出了一次越獄，將放在一邊的[[嫌犯]]敵人生成在一個[[三樓]]地點，或者如果場上沒有[[三樓]]地點，則生成在宏偉入口(忽略該敵人的顯現能力)。將放在一邊的藍色鑰匙放在該敵人上。 - 否則，調查員隊長查找遭遇牌堆，找出一個[[異教徒]]敵人，將其生成在連接地點。混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Initiation (v. II)
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: Remove 2 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag. Check Campaign Log. - If a jailbreak is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log, spawn the set-aside [[Suspect]] enemy at a [[Third Floor]] location, or at the Grand Entryway if a [[Third Floor]] location is not in play (ignoring that enemy's revelation ability). That enemy enters play exhausted. - Otherwise, nothing else happens.
cards.back_text_cn: 從混亂袋中移除2個[curse]標記。檢查冒險日誌。 - 如果如果冒險日誌中，"恢復記憶"下方，列出了一次越獄，將放在一邊的[[嫌犯]]敵人生成在一個[[三樓]]地點，或者如果場上沒有[[三樓]]地點，則生成在宏偉入口(忽略該敵人的顯現能力)。該敵人以消耗狀態入場。 - 否則，無事發生。

cards.name: What Lurks Below (v. I)
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: Add 4 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
cards.back_text_cn: 在混亂袋中加入4個[curse]標記。

cards.name: What Lurks Below (v. II)
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text:
Remove 4 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag.
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Thomas Dawson story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, Thomas Dawson does not take up an ally slot. That investigator may also take control of 1 spent key on the scenario reference card.
cards.back_text_cn:
從混亂袋中移除4個[curse]標記。
選擇一位調查員控制放在一邊的托馬斯·道森劇情支援。托馬斯·道森不佔用盟友槽，直到本場冒險結束。該調查員也可以控制冒險輔助卡上一個已花費的鑰匙。

cards.name: The Ritual Advances
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. In your Campaign Log, record Dagon has awakened. (→R1)
cards.back_text_cn: 每位未撤退的調查員被擊敗並受到1點精神創傷。 在冒險日誌中，記錄達貢已甦醒。 (→結局1)

cards.name: The First Oath
cards.text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at Grand Entryway and the investigators have "unlocked the entrance to the caves," advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[嫌犯]]敵人得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，失去冷漠且不能與之談判。 [fast]花費藍色、紅色、白色或黃色鑰匙：丟棄每張疊加到你所在地點的[[屏障]]卡牌。 目標 - 如果所有倖存的調查員都在宏偉入口且調查員"解鎖了洞穴的入口"，推進場景。
cards.back_text: If a [[Suspect]] enemy is in play, remove it from the game. Remove each location other than Grand Entryway from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them), discarding each card at those locations. Shuffle the set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations and put each of them into play. Increase the flood level of each location. Shuffle each set-aside Syzygy and Tidal Alignment card into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 如果有[[嫌犯]]敵人在場上，將其從遊戲中移除。 將除宏偉入口外的每個地點從遊戲中移除(如果其有勝利X且無線索，則將其加入勝利牌區)，丟棄這些點的所有卡牌。 混洗放在一邊的潮水通道地點，將其全部放置入場。 提升每個地點的淹沒等級。 將放在一邊的朔望和星潮合相卡牌，和遭遇棄牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Second Oath
cards.text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - If an investigator has "unlocked the final depths," advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[嫌犯]]敵人得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，失去冷漠且不能與之談判。 [fast]花費藍色、紅色、白色或黃色鑰匙：丟棄每張疊加到你所在地點的[[屏障]]卡牌。 目標 - 如果有調查員"解鎖了最終深淵"，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Put the set-aside Lair of Dagon location into play, fully flooded. Put the set-aside Dagon enemy into play at Lair of Dagon, (Deep in Slumber) side faceup. Check the current agenda. - If it is agenda 1a, add 10 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. - If it is agenda 2a, add 5 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的達貢巢穴地點放置入場，完全淹沒。 將放在一邊的達貢敵人放置入場，放在達貢巢穴，(深入沉睡)面朝上。 檢查當前密謀。 - 如果是密謀1a，在混亂袋中加入10個[curse]標記。 - 如果是密謀2a，在混亂袋中加入5個[curse]標記。

cards.name: The Third Oath
cards.text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - Disrupt the Order's ritual by placing clues on this act. If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on this act, advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[嫌犯]]敵人得到+1[per_investigator]生命值，失去冷漠且不能與之談判。 [fast]花費藍色、紅色、白色或黃色鑰匙：丟棄每張疊加到你所在地點的[[屏障]]卡牌。 目標 - 在本場景上放置線索，以此破壞密教的儀式。如果本場景上有3[per_investigator]個線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text: In your Campaign Log, record the Order's ritual was disrupted. - If Dagon (Deep in Slumber) is in play, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon still slumbers. - If Dagon (Awakened and Enraged) is in play or in the victory display, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon has awakened. (→R1)
cards.back_text_cn: 在冒險日誌中，記錄密教的儀式被破壞。 - 如果達貢(深入沉睡)在場上，在冒險日誌中，記錄下達貢仍沉睡。 - 如果達貢(甦醒狂怒)在場上或勝利牌區，在冒險日誌中，記錄下達貢已甦醒。 (→結局1)

cards.name: Grand Entryway
cards.text: Grand Entryway is connected to each [[Cave]] location, and vice versa. [action] Resign. You've had enough of this place. [action] Investigators at the Grand Entryway spend the purple key and 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you have "unlocked the entrance to the caves".
cards.text_cn: 宏偉入口與每個[[洞穴]]地點相互連接。 [action] 撤退。你受夠了這個地方。 [action]在宏偉入口的調查員以團隊為單位，花費紫色鑰匙和3[per_investigator]個線索：請記住你"解鎖了洞穴的入口"。

cards.name: Hall of Blood
cards.text: Forced - After Hall of Blood is revealed: Place the set-aside red key on it. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Hall of Blood: Take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在鮮血廳堂揭示後：將放在一邊的紅色鑰匙放在上面。 強制 - 調查鮮血廳堂時，在你技能檢定失敗後：受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Hall of the Deep
cards.text: [action] Spend the red key: There is an audible click as the crest of blood fits into the stone altar. Put the set-aside Y'ha-nthlei Statue story asset into play under your control, [[Cursed]] side faceup. Forced - After Hall of the Deep is revealed: Increase its flood level.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費紅色鑰匙：血之紋章在石頭祭壇上完美契合，發出一聲清晰的喀噠。將放在一邊的伊哈·恩斯雷雕塑劇情支援放置入場，放在你的控制之下，[[詛咒縈繞]]面朝上。 強制 - 在深海廳堂揭示後：提升其淹沒等級。

cards.name: Foul Corridors
cards.text: [action] Spend the black key: Remember that you have "unlocked the third floor."
cards.text_cn: [action]花費黑色鑰匙：請記住你"解鎖了三樓"。

cards.name: Hall of Loyalty
cards.text:
[fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Choose 3 of the following - 
- Heal 1 damage.
- Draw 2 cards.
- Gain 3 resources.
- Add 4 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.
cards.text_cn:
[fast]花費藍色、紅色、白色或黃色鑰匙：選擇以下其中3項——
- 治癒1點傷害。
- 抽取2張卡牌。
- 獲得3資源。
- 在混亂袋中加入4個[bless]標記。

cards.name: Hall of Rebirth
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal Hall of Rebirth: Draw the set-aside Apostle of Dagon enemy.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你揭示重生廳堂後：抽取放在一邊的達貢宣教士敵人。

cards.name: Hall of Silence
cards.text: Forced - After Hall of Silence is revealed: Place the set-aside purple key on it. Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在寂靜廳堂揭示後：將放在一邊的紫色鑰匙放在上面。 強制 - 在本地點的調查員技能檢定失敗後：在混亂袋中加入1個[curse]標記。
cards.back_text: Investigators cannot move to Third Floor Hall unless an investigator has "unlocked the third floor."
cards.back_text_cn: 調查員不能移動到三樓廳室，除非有調查員已經"解鎖了三樓"。

cards.name: Doorway to the Depths
cards.text: Forced - After Doorway to the Depths is revealed: Place the set-aside green key on the location with the most clues. [action] Investigators at the Doorway to the Depths spend the green key and 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you have "unlocked the final depths."
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在深淵門扉揭示後：將放在一邊的綠色鑰匙放在線索最多的地點上。 [action]在深淵門扉的調查員以團隊為單位，花費綠色鑰匙和3個[per_investigator]線索：請記住你"解鎖了最終深淵"。

cards.name: Lair of Dagon
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Lair of Dagon: Test your lowest skill (3). If you fail, take 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on the current act. You may spend 1 key to place 1 more of your clues on the current act.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入達貢巢穴後：檢定你最低的技能值(3)。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點恐懼。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)或[agility](3)。如果你檢定成功，將你的1個線索放到當前場景上。你可以花費1個鑰匙以再將你的1個線索放到當前場景上。

cards.name: Dagon
cards.text: Massive. Dagon gets +6 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Ready Dagon. Dagon attacks that investigator.
cards.text_cn: 龐大。 達貢得到+6[per_investigator]生命值。 強制 - 在位於本地點的調查員技能檢定失敗後：準備達貢。達貢攻擊該調查員。

cards.name: Apostle of Dagon
cards.text: Apostle of Dagon gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Apostle of Dagon enters play: Place the set-aside black key on it. Forced - When an investigator deals 1 or more damage to Apostle of Dagon: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.
cards.text_cn: 達貢宣教士得到+1[per_investigator]生命值。 強制 - 在達貢宣教士入場後：將放在一邊的黑色鑰匙放在上面。 強制 - 在調查員對達貢宣教士造成一次傷害時：在混亂袋中加入1個[curse]標記。

cards.name: Cerenerian Deep One
cards.text: Prey - Lowest [willpower]. Hunter. Forced - After Cerenerian Deep One engages you: Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 最低[willpower]的目標。 獵手。 強制 - 在瑟瑞尼連海深潛者與你交戰後：在混亂袋中加入2個[curse]標記。

cards.name: Fulfill the Oaths
cards.text: Revelation - If it is... - ... act 1, test [agility] (3). - ... act 2, test [agility] (3), then [combat] (2). - ... act 3, test [agility] (3), then [combat] (2), then [intellect] (2). For each of these skill tests you fail, take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果是…… - ……場景1，檢定[agility](3)。 - ……場景2，檢定[agility](3)，然後[combat](2)。 - ……場景3，檢定[agility](3)，然後[combat](2)，然後[intellect](2)。 這些技能檢定中你每失敗一次，受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Secret Gathering
cards.text: Revelation - Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag. Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, place 1 doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy and take 1 horror (2 horror instead if 1 or more [curse] tokens were revealed during this test).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 在混亂袋中加入1個[curse]標記。檢定[willpower](4)。如果你檢定失敗，在每個[[異教徒]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記並受到1點恐懼(如果本次檢定期間抽出了[curse]標記，改為2點恐懼)。

cards.name: Esoteric Ritual
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand or discard an asset you control (if 1 or more [curse] tokens were revealed during this test, do both instead).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](4)。如果你檢定失敗，選擇並丟棄你2張手牌，或丟棄一個你控制的支援(本次檢定期間抽出了[curse]標記，則改為兩者都執行)。

cards.name: Heralds of the Deep
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3) (5 instead if your location is flooded). For each point you fail by, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag (if you cannot, Heralds of the Deep gains surge).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)(如果你所在地點已淹沒，難度改為5)。你檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，在混亂袋中加入1個[curse]標記(如果你不能，深海兆使獲得湧動)。

cards.name: Stone Barrier
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a Stone Barrier attached. If attached location is flooded, Stone Barrier gains surge. While Stone Barrier is ready, investigators cannot move out of attached location. [action]: Test [agility] (1), [combat] (2), or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, exhaust Stone Barrier.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到最近的沒有疊加石障的地點。如果疊加地點已淹沒，石障獲得湧動。 石障準備時，調查員不能移動離開疊加地點。 [action]：檢定[agility](1)、[combat](2)，或[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，消耗石障。

cards.name: Y'ha-nthlei Statue
cards.text:
[fast] Exhaust Y'ha-nthlei Statue: Deal 1 damage to a [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Y'ha-nthlei Statue: Remove 2 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag and replace them with an equal number of [bless] tokens.
cards.text_cn:
[fast]消耗伊哈·恩斯雷雕塑：對你所在地點的一個[[類人]]敵人造成1點傷害。
[fast]消耗伊哈·恩斯雷雕塑: 從混亂袋中移除2個[curse]標記，用同等數量的[bless]標記將其替換。

cards.name: Into the Maelstrom
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there are 4 or more unflooded [[Y'ha-nthlei]] locations in play).
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current agenda (this may cause the current agenda to advance).
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, you must either increase the flood level of your location or take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail and there is a key on your location, take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果場上有至少4個未淹沒的[[伊哈·恩斯雷]]地點，改為-3)。
[cultist]：-3。如果你檢定失敗，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果能導致當前密謀推進)。
[tablet]：-4。如果你檢定失敗，你必須提升你所在地點的淹沒等級，或受到1點傷害。
[elder_thing]：-5。如果你檢定失敗，且你所在地點有鑰匙，受到1點恐懼。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if there are 4 or more unflooded [[Y'ha-nthlei]] locations in play).
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current agenda (this may cause the current agenda to advance).
[tablet]: -5. If you fail, you must either increase the flood level of your location or take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -6. If you fail and there is a key on your location, take 1 horror.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2(如果場上有至少4個未淹沒的[[伊哈·恩斯雷]]地點，改為-4)。
[cultist]：-4。如果你檢定失敗，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果能導致當前密謀推進)。
[tablet]：-5。如果你檢定失敗，你必須提升你所在地點的淹沒等級，或受到1點傷害。
[elder_thing]：-6。如果你檢定失敗，且你所在地點有鑰匙，受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Under the Surface
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Lloigor enemy and the set-aside Aquatic Abomination enemy into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的洛依高爾敵人和放在一邊的水生異怪敵人和遭遇棄牌堆一起混洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Celestial Alignment
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。
cards.back_text: If Hydra is in play, flip her to her (Awakened and Enraged) side. If Dagon is in play and slumbering, flip him to his (Awakened and Enraged) side.
cards.back_text_cn: 如果海德拉在場上，將她翻至(甦醒狂怒)面。 如果達貢在場上且在沉睡，將他翻至(甦醒狂怒)面。

cards.name: The Flood
cards.text: If an [[Ancient One]] enemy is slumbering, flip it to its (Awakened and Enraged) side. Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 如果有[[古神]]敵人沉睡，將其翻至(甦醒狂怒)面。 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你在完全淹沒的地點，你奮力掙扎，求取空氣：在你回合結束時，如果你在自己回合期間沒有進入過未淹沒或部分淹沒的地點，受到5點直接傷害。

cards.name: Back into the Depths
cards.text: Objective - If each investigator is at Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei and the investigators possess each of the following keys (blue, red, yellow, and green), you may choose to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果每位調查員都在伊哈·恩斯雷門扉，且調查員控制了藍色、紅色、黃色和綠色鑰匙，你可以選擇推進場景。(FAQ, v1.9)
cards.back_text: Remove each location other than Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues remaining). Discard each card at those locations. Put set-aside locations into play as shown in the Campaign Guide, following the "Act 2 Setup" instructions. (Note that the number of Y'ha-nthlei locations used and the arrangement of the locations varies depending on the number of investigators in the game.) Put the set-aside Hydra enemy into play in the Lair of Hydra, (Deep in Slumber) side faceup. Put the set-aside Dagon enemy into play in the Lair of Dagon. Check Campaign Log. If Dagon has awakened, he enters play (Awakened and Enraged) side faceup. If Dagon still slumbers, he enters play (Deep in Slumber) side faceup.
cards.back_text_cn: 將除伊哈·恩斯雷門扉外的每個地點從遊戲中移除(如果其有勝利X且無線索，則將其加入勝利牌區)。丟棄這些地點的所有卡牌。 按照劇本手冊上"場景2設置"的指令，將放在一邊的地點放置入場。(注意隨著遊戲中調查員人數的不同，會用到的伊哈·恩斯雷地點數量和其佈局也會不同。) 將放在一邊的海德拉敵人放置入場，放在海德拉巢穴，(深入沉睡)面朝上。 將放在一邊的達貢敵人放置入場，放在達貢巢穴。檢查冒險日誌。如果達貢已甦醒，他以(甦醒狂怒)面入場。如果達貢仍沉睡，他以(深入沉睡)面入場。

cards.name: City of the Deep (v. I)
cards.text: [fast] Either remove 1 [per_investigator] damage from an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location, or investigators at a [[Lair]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease the flood level of any non-[[Sanctum]] location in play Objective - Stop the Deep Ones' ritual by draining the city. If each location in play is unflooded, advance.
cards.text_cn: [fast]從你所在地點的一個[[古神]]敵人上移除1[per_investigator]點傷害，或在一個[[巢穴]]地點的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：降低場上任一非[[聖堂]]地點的淹沒等級。 目標 - 要阻止深潛者的儀式，你得抽乾整座城市。如果場上每個地點都未淹沒，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
cards.back_text_cn: 將本卡牌加入勝利牌區。 - 如果場上有另一張場景卡，你可以選擇繼續遊戲，以完成該場景卡上的目標；或者不完成該目標，立即進入(→結局1)。 - 如果場上沒有其他場景卡，進入(→結局1)。 勝利2。

cards.name: City of the Deep (v. II)
cards.text: Objective - Recover the riches of the Deep Ones. If the Lair of Dagon, the Lair of Hydra, and the Vault of Riches with the purple key have no clues on them, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 重獲深潛者的寶藏。如果達貢巢穴、海德拉巢穴和放置了紫色鑰匙的財富寶庫上都沒有線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
cards.back_text_cn: 將本卡牌加入勝利牌區。 - 如果場上有另一張場景卡，你可以選擇繼續遊戲，以完成該場景卡上的目標；或者不完成該目標，立即進入(→結局1)。 - 如果場上沒有其他場景卡，進入(→結局1)。 勝利2。

cards.name: City of the Deep (v. III)
cards.text: Objective - Collapse the vault containing the Deep Ones' riches. If Dagon and Hydra each have at least 4 [per_investigator] damage on them, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 摧毀容納深潛者財富的寶庫。如果達貢和海德拉上各有至少4[per_investigator]傷害，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
cards.back_text_cn: 將本卡牌加入勝利牌區。 - 如果場上有另一張場景卡，你可以選擇繼續遊戲，以完成該場景卡上的目標；或者不完成該目標，立即進入(→結局1)。 - 如果場上沒有其他場景卡，進入(→結局1)。 勝利2。

cards.name: Dark Abyss
cards.text: Forced - After Dark Abyss is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Dark Abyss without looking at it. Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Dark Abyss: Dark Abyss becomes fully flooded. Increase the flood level of each location connected to Dark Abyss.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在黑暗深淵揭示後：從放在一邊正面朝下的鑰匙中隨機選擇1個，放到黑暗深淵上，不要查看。 強制 - 在黑暗深淵上最後的線索被發現後：黑暗深淵完全淹沒。提升與黑暗深淵連接的每個地點的淹沒等級。

cards.name: Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei
cards.back_text: Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).
cards.back_text_cn: 伊哈·恩斯雷門扉以部分淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Sunken Halls
cards.text: [action] If you control the black key: Place it on Sunken Halls. Forced - After an enemy enters Sunken Halls, if the black key is on Sunken Halls: Deal 2 damage to that enemy.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制黑色鑰匙：將其放在沉沒廳堂上。 強制 - 在敵人進入沉沒廳堂後，如果黑色鑰匙在沉沒廳堂上：對該敵人造成2點傷害。
cards.back_text: Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).
cards.back_text_cn: 伊哈·恩斯雷以部分淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Vault of Riches
cards.text: [action] If you control the purple key: Place it on Vault of Riches. Then, choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at any location. Automatically evade that enemy and move it to Vault of Riches. That enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制紫色鑰匙：將其放在財富寶庫上。然後，選擇任意地點的一個非[[精英]]敵人。自動躲避該敵人並將其移動到財富寶庫上。該敵人在下一個補給階段期間不準備。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)
cards.back_text: Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).
cards.back_text_cn: 伊哈·恩斯雷以部分淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Undersea Corridors
cards.text: [action] If you control the white key: Place it on Undersea Corridors. [fast] If the white key is on Undersea Corridors: Move. Move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制了白色鑰匙：將其放在海下長廊上。 [fast]如果白色鑰匙在海下長廊上：移動。移動到一個連接地點。(每輪限制一次)。
cards.back_text: Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).
cards.back_text_cn: 伊哈·恩斯雷以部分淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Statues in the Deep
cards.text: [action] If you control the blue key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating this location: Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制藍色鑰匙，將其放在本地點上，且本地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：自動躲避每個[[古神]]敵人。移除本地點的淹沒標記。本場遊戲剩餘時間內，本地點不能被淹沒。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。) 強制 - 調查本地點時，在你技能檢定失敗後：受到1點傷害。
cards.back_text: Y'ha-nthlei Sanctum enters play fully flooded (even while it is unrevealed).
cards.back_text_cn: 伊哈·恩斯雷聖堂以完全淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Submerged Temple
cards.text:
Each [[Deep One]] enemy at this location gets +2 fight.
[action] If you control the green key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn:
本地點的每個[[深潛者]]敵人得到+2攻擊值。
[action]如果你控制綠色鑰匙，將其放在本地點上，且本地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：自動躲避每個[[古神]]敵人。移除本地點的淹沒標記。本場遊戲剩餘時間內，本地點不能被淹沒。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.back_text_cn: 伊哈·恩斯雷聖堂以完全淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Syzygy Chamber
cards.text: [action] If you control the red key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After any location's flood value is increased: Each investigator at this location takes 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制紅色鑰匙，將其放在本地點上，且本地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：自動躲避每個[[古神]]敵人。移除本地點的淹沒標記。本場遊戲剩餘時間內，本地點不能被淹沒。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。) 強制 - 在任意地點的淹沒等級提升後：本地點的每位調查員受到1點恐懼。

cards.back_text_cn: 伊哈·恩斯雷聖堂以完全淹沒入場(即使其未揭示)。

cards.name: Onyx Guardians
cards.text:
During the enemy phase, each ready [[Ancient One]] enemy can attack investigators here as if they were engaged.
[action] If you control the yellow key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn:
敵軍階段期間，每個準備的[[古神]]敵人可以攻擊本地點的調查員，如同其已交戰。
[action]如果你控制黃色鑰匙，將其放在本地點上，且本地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：自動躲避每個[[古神]]敵人。移除本地點的淹沒標記。本場遊戲剩餘時間內，本地點不能被淹沒。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Lair of Dagon
cards.text: Lair of Dagon gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it. [fast] Check Campaign Log. If all 7 keys are on locations and the Order's ritual was disrupted: You dig deep into your memories to recall what happened the last time you were here. Read Flashback XIV in the Campaign Guide.
cards.text_cn: 每有一個[[聖堂]]地點上有鑰匙，達貢巢穴得到-1隱藏值。 [fast]檢查冒險日誌。如果如果所有7個鑰匙都在地點上，且密教的儀式被破壞：你深挖記憶，回想自己上次在此時發生了什麼。閱讀劇本手冊的記憶閃回XIV。

cards.name: Lair of Hydra
cards.text:
Lair of Hydra gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
[action] Place the black, purple, or white key on this location: Deal 3 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy that is not slumbering. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn:
每有一個[[聖堂]]地點上有鑰匙，海德拉巢穴得到-1隱藏值。
[action]將黑色、紫色或白色鑰匙放在本地點上：對個未沉睡的[[古神]]敵人造成3點傷害。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

meta.subname_cn: 母神海德拉的高階神廟

cards.name: Dagon
cards.text: Dagon is slumbering. He cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects. Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if an investigator is in Lair of Dagon and Dagon is ready: Place 1 doom on him. [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either exhaust Dagon or remove 1 doom from him. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on him.
cards.text_cn: 達貢正在沉睡。他不能攻擊，不能與調查員交戰，免疫調查員行動和玩家卡效果。 強制 - 當調查階段結束時，如果有調查員在達貢巢穴，且達貢已準備：在達貢上放置1個毀滅標記。(FAQ, v2.0) [action]：檢定[willpower](4)。如果你檢定成功，消耗達貢或移除他的1個毀滅標記。如果你檢定失敗且低於難度至少3點，在達貢上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Hydra
cards.text: Hydra is slumbering. She cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects. Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if an investigator is in Lair of Hydra and Hydra is ready: Place 1 doom on her. [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either exhaust Hydra or remove 1 doom from her. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on her.
cards.text_cn: 海德拉正在沉睡。她不能攻擊，不能與調查員交戰，免疫調查員行動和玩家卡效果。 強制 - 當調查階段結束時，如果有調查員在海德拉巢穴，且海德拉已準備：在海德拉上放置1個毀滅標記。(FAQ, v2.0) [action]：檢定[willpower](4)。如果你檢定成功，消耗海德拉或移除她的1個毀滅標記。如果你檢定失敗且低於難度至少3點，在海德拉上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Aquatic Abomination
cards.text:
Hunter.
While Aquatic Abomination is moving, fully flooded locations are considered to be connected to one another.
Aquatic Abomination cannot attack during the same phase it moved via its hunter keyword.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
水生異怪移動時，完全淹沒的地點視為相互連接。
水生異怪在通過其獵手關鍵詞移動的同一階段期間不能攻擊。

cards.name: Dagon's Brood
cards.text: Spawn - Lair of Dagon or Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei (whichever is farther from you). Hunter. Forced - After Dagon's Brood engages you, if Dagon is in play: Either place 1 doom on Dagon, or Dagon attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 達貢巢穴或伊哈·恩斯雷門扉(其中離你更遠的地點)。 獵手。 強制 - 在達貢之子與你交戰後，如果達貢在場上：在達貢上放置1個毀滅標記，或達貢攻擊你。

cards.name: Hydra's Brood
cards.text: Spawn - Lair of Hydra or Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei (whichever is farther from you). Hunter. Forced - After Hydra's Brood engages you, if Hydra is in play: Either place 1 doom on Hydra, or Hydra attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 海德拉巢穴或伊哈·恩斯雷門扉(其中離你更遠的地點)。 獵手。 強制 - 在海德拉之子與你交戰後，如果海德拉在場上：在海德拉上放置1個毀滅標記，或海德拉攻擊你。

cards.name: Treacherous Depths
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Increase the flood level of your current location. - Discard assets from your play area with a total resource cost of at least X, where X is your location's shroud value.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須(選擇一項)： - 提升你當前地點的淹沒等級。 - 丟棄你遊戲區域總計資源費用至少為X的支援，其中X為你所在地點的隱藏值。

cards.name: Conspiracy of Deep Ones
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it. If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance), or the nearest [[Ancient One]] enemy in play attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。每有一個[[聖堂]]地點上有鑰匙，本次檢定難度+1。如果你檢定失敗，你必須在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果能導致當前密謀推進)，或在場上的最近的[[古神]]敵人攻擊你。

cards.name: Thalassophobia
cards.text: Revelation - If no investigators are at flooded locations, Thalassophobia gains surge. Otherwise, each investigator at a partially flooded location takes 1 horror, and each investigator at a fully flooded location takes 1 direct horror that cannot be prevented.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果沒有調查員在淹沒的地點，深海恐懼症獲得湧動。否則，每位在部分淹沒地點的調查員受到1點恐懼，每位在完全淹沒地點的調查員受到1點不能防止的直接恐懼。

cards.name: Diving Suit
cards.text: You ignore the Forced ability on the current agenda. Forced - When any amount of damage would be placed on you: Place 1 of that damage on Diving Suit. Forced - When Diving Suit leaves play: Remove it from the game.
cards.text_cn: 你忽略當前密謀的強制能力。 強制 - 在任意數量的傷害將要放置到你身上時：將此傷害中的1點放到潛水服上。 強制 - 在潛水服離場時：將其從遊戲中移除。
